jobs.title: Director of Engineering, Cloud Product Engineering
jobs.description:
Aerospike is powering the next generation of real-time, massive-scale applications—and we need an exceptional Director of Engineering to build the gateway to it all. You will own the vision, architecture, and execution for how thousands of developers and enterprise teams interact with, pay for, and observe the Aerospike Cloud Platform.
This isn't just about managing code; it’s about shaping the entire developer journey across our multi-cloud, multi-tenant ecosystem. You will lead the charge on everything from lightning-fast UI/API experiences to complex usage-based monetization and real-time telemetry pipelines handling massive data flows.
To foster strong alignment and execution, Bay Area–based leaders are expected in-office Tuesday through Thursday.
We need a high-octane strategic leader who loves big technical challenges, thrives on building high-impact teams, and stays close enough to the tech to drive serious architectural authority. Partnering directly with executive leaders in Product, Design, Finance, and Infrastructure, you will transform complex, distributed database capabilities into an effortless, intuitive, and wildly reliable cloud service.

What You’ll Do

Build & Scale a World-Class Org:
Empower, mentor, and grow a premier organization of engineering managers, technical leads, and full-stack/frontend engineers. Drive a high-velocity culture rooted in innovation, autonomy, and delivery.
Revolutionize the Customer Experience:
Define the multi-year vision for our developer consoles, APIs, and user-facing workflows—ensuring every interaction with Aerospike Cloud is fast, friction-free, and delightful.
Architect the Core Business Engine (BLT):

Monetization & Usage:
Spearhead the architectural evolution of our high-volume billing engines, real-time usage tracking, and multi-cloud marketplace integrations (AWS, GCP, Azure, Stripe).
Licensing & Entitlements:
Build bulletproof, multi-tenant entitlement systems and feature-gating frameworks designed for global enterprise scale.
Telemetry & Observability:
Drive the strategy for deep, real-time observability (metrics, logs, traces) that turns billions of platform events into actionable insights for both our engineers and customers.
Drive Technical Excellence:
Serve as the ultimate bar-raiser for microservices architecture, API design, and modern frontend systems. Keep the tech stack cutting-edge while eliminating complexity.
Align Tech with Business Growth:
Translate big-picture enterprise strategy into clear, executable technical roadmaps alongside Product, Revenue, and Executive Leadership.
Own Production Reliability:
Establish non-negotiable standards for billing precision, sub-second interface performance, and enterprise-grade SLA availability in a 24/7/365 cloud environment.

What We’re Looking For

10+ years
scaling customer-facing SaaS, PaaS, or cloud infrastructure platforms at serious velocity.
4+ years
of progressive engineering leadership experience, with a proven track record of managing managers, scaling teams, and leading through technical leads.
Domain Powerhouse:
Deep expertise in architecting cloud monetization engines (metered billing, marketplace integrations) and high-throughput telemetry/observability platforms (OpenTelemetry, Datadog, Prometheus).
Deep Technical DNA:
Hands-on foundation in modern web stacks (React, TypeScript), scalable API design (REST, GraphQL), and cloud-native infrastructure (Kubernetes, Go, multi-cloud platforms).
Executive Presence & Business Acumen:
A clear, compelling communicator who seamlessly connects deep technical architecture to revenue strategy, product execution, and executive goals.
Battle-Tested Operational Ownership:
Proven experience running high-availability, mission-critical production systems where downtime or inaccuracy is not an option.

Nice to Have

Experience building developer consoles, control planes, or management interfaces for NoSQL databases, data platforms, or high-throughput infrastructure.
Direct experience leading engineering through periods of rapid scaling, enterprise transformations, or major cloud platform expansions.
Hands-on familiarity with distributed systems, event-driven architectures, or technologies like Temporal and Node.js.
Familiarity with distributed systems or high-scale databases.

Salary Range
: $272,000 – $350,000
(Actual compensation will be based on experience, location, and other relevant factors.)

jobs.title: Engineering Director
jobs.description:
Blykalla is working toward deploying its first reactor in the United States, with planned activities connected to Idaho National Laboratory (INL). We are looking for an Engineering Director to build and lead our US engineering team and enable execution of Blykalla’s reference design in the US context.

This is a first-of-a-kind project at an early stage. You will be the person who makes Blykalla’s reference design actually work in the US — technically, regulatorily, and organizationally.

Our US program, Fjäll, targets first criticality in 2027, with full power by 2029–31. We are building this from the ground up — every hire is foundational.

Your assignment

As Engineering Director, you will lead the US engineering team and ensure that Blykalla’s reference design is executed in the US program. You act as the US engineering lead within the program, working closely with Blykalla’s R&D organization to preserve design intent while enabling practical execution in the US.

You report to the VP of Engineering, with a dotted line to the Head of US Project Development in Austin.

Key responsibilities

US Engineering Execution

Own the engineering needed to execute Blykalla’s reference design in the US. Ensure that design and R&D are turned into deliverables that can be built, installed, and operated in the US program. Identify gaps early and drive resolution.

Team Build-Up

Build and lead the US engineering team across key disciplines. Phase hiring in line with the project schedule and execution needs.

R&D Organization Interface

Act as the primary interface to the R&D organization. Maintain design intent, manage change control, and ensure alignment on technical decisions.

Licensing Support

Provide engineering input to the DOE Authorization process (NSDA, PDSA, DSA). Ensure that engineering outputs meet US expectations for structure, rigor, and traceability.

External Interfaces

Own engineering interfaces with INL, Oklo, and US partners. Represent engineering in technical discussions and ensure commitments are delivered.

Codes & Standards Alignment

Ensure that engineering outputs are aligned with relevant US codes and standards (e.g., ASME BPVC, ANSI/ANS, ASCE, IEEE) and QA expectations (NQA-1). Support the adaptation of Blykalla’s reference design to meet US regulatory and industry requirements.

Your first 90 days

Establish gaps between Blykalla’s reference design and US execution needs, and deliver a first engineering package or gap closure.
Build the US engineering hiring plan aligned with project milestones, and hire the first 1–2 key engineers.
Define the US–R&D organization operating model.
Establish key interfaces (R&D organization and US partners).
Identify top execution risks and mitigation pathways.

What we’re looking for

We’re looking for someone who can lead, build, and bridge.

Must have

10+ years of engineering experience from highly regulated industries (e.g., oil & gas, nuclear), including experience with US nuclear.
Experience leading multidisciplinary engineering teams.
Experience working across organizations and geographies.
Strong understanding of engineering execution in complex projects.
Relevant engineering degree.
Strong communication skills.
Ability to operate in a build-phase organization.
US work authorization.

Strong advantage

Experience with US nuclear codes and standards (ASME, ANSI/ANS, etc.).
Familiarity with DOE Authorization / 10 CFR 830.
Experience with advanced reactors or FOAK programs.

If you’re not sure you meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply.

About Blykalla

Blykalla is developing the next generation of nuclear technology with our Small Modular Reactor (SMR) based on innovative fuel, materials, and reactor designs. As Sweden’s only SMR developer, we are on a mission to decarbonize industries and enable safe, scalable, and sustainable energy solutions. Our technology uses lead coolant, creating novel challenges and opportunities for the fuel cycle and supporting systems.

Our US development program, Fjäll, is working toward deploying Blykalla’s first reactor in the United States, targeting first criticality in 2027. We are standing up this program from scratch, which means every hire matters and every role is foundational.

Location

Austin, TX. Occasional travel to Stockholm, Sweden.

Compensation & Benefits

We offer a competitive compensation package reflecting the seniority and strategic importance of this role.

Base salary: $170,000–$220,000 annually, depending on experience and background.

In addition, you can expect:

Equity participation
Comprehensive benefits through Deel, including medical, dental, and vision insurance and 401(k)

The salary range reflects our target band for Austin. The final offer will be determined based on qualifications.

So, what do you think?

Joining our team means being part of a pioneering effort to deploy the first advanced lead-cooled SMR in the United States. You will lead US engineering at the intersection of advanced reactor design, US codes and standards, and DOE Authorization — and build the team that delivers it.

If you are ready to build something that matters, apply now.

We are proud to foster an inclusive workplace free from discrimination. We strongly believe that diversity of experience, perspectives, and background makes us better — and we encourage everyone to apply.

We do not accept applications via email.

jobs.title: Director of Engineering
jobs.description:
Job Number: 26-00606

Use your skills where innovative technology solutions begin. ECLARO is looking for a Director of Engineering
for our client in Richardson, TX.

ECLARO’s client is a leading technology solutions provider, collaborating with customers to manage their needs and achieve success in their business goals. If you’re up to the challenge, then take a chance at this rewarding opportunity!

Position Overview:

Director of Engineering is a high-impact senior leadership role, responsible for the end-to-end cellular engineering, including mobile network (core and RAN) management as well as deployment and technical management of innovative wholesale solutions in a secure, effective, scalable and commercially viable manner, to customers across the world.
This role manages and leads a geographically dispersed multidisciplinary engineering team covering IP, 4G / LTE, IMS, 5G NSA / SA, NTN, SIM/ eSIM, BSS / billing as well as global roaming and wholesale.

Responsibilities:

Leadership & Management:
Provide strategic and technical leadership for cellular engineering functions.
Act as the final engineering authority for production readiness, operational acceptance, and NOC handover of all deployed solutions.
Lead and manage a geographically dispersed engineering team responsible for both open-source and vendor supplied LTE core (MME, SGW, PGW), IMS (VoLTE / VoNR) as well as 5G core (AMF, SMF, UPF, UDM, AUSF, PCF, NRF) infrastructure.
Ownership for mobile core network infrastructure nodes and their operational management, including roadmaps / lifecycle planning, upgrades, vendor relationships, dimensioning, etc.
Technical and operational ownership of roaming infrastructure for 4G / LTE as well as 5G NSA / SA, including SEPP as well as TAP and BCE billing.
Ownership of SIM lifecycle management including IMSI and MSISDN allocations, SIM and eSIM configurations and provisioning, and any other identity parameters on eSIM using OTA platform.
Ownership of bespoke software development needs.
Ownership for Limitless Mobile RAN as well as lab toy cells used for testing and customer demonstrations.
Ownership of technical end-to-end process for CDR generation to mediation function needed for rating and billing.

Planning:
Implement and manage tools and processes to effectively plan and manage utilization of engineering resources.
Create and manage an engineering delivery roadmap for Limitless Mobile to enhance various platforms for the 5G NSA / SA as well as 6G in the future.
Ownership of capacity management for mobile core network and RAN.

Projects:
Technical ownership of solution deployment for contracted wholesale customers as well as relevant internal projects.
Establish and enforce standard deployment patterns, reference architectures, and baseline configurations for core, RAN, roaming, and wholesale solutions to reduce deployment variability and operational risk.
Work with assigned Project Manager to lead complex, long-duration (weeks or months) projects ensuring on-time and on-budget delivery.
Create, implement, and drive High Level Design (HLD), Low level design (LLD) including final documentation.
Drive the creation of acceptance test plans to be used to verify the solutions during the implementation projects and as customer acceptance criteria. The main objectives of these test plans are to successfully deliver the solution, to secure customer.
Ensure all projects have full documentation and are properly transitioned to the Network Operations Centre (NOC) for post-launch operation.
Work with assigned Project Manager to conduct a post mortem at the end of each project to identify learnings that can be applied in future projects.

Operations & Support:
Ensure NOC team is sufficiently trained on new solutions to facilitate effective post-launch delivery and support.
Maintain ongoing accountability for the operational health of deployed platforms, including recurring incident analysis, trend review, and continuous improvement of monitoring, alerting, and runbooks in collaboration with the NOC.
Own the identification, prioritization, and remediation of technical depth across network platforms, tooling, and automation, balancing short-term delivery pressure with long-term operational sustainability.
Ensure Engineering supports NOC by providing Tier 2 support, including critical network incidents and service-impacting issues through a 24x7 rotation program (for emergencies and critical issues).

Organizational Development:
Establish engineering best practices, governance, documentation, and operational excellence standards.
Drive the adoption of automation, analytics, and ML-assisted tooling specifically to reduce mean time to detect (MTTD), mean time to restore (MTTR), operational cost, and manual intervention across engineering and NOC workflows.
Create and execute a plan for continuous development of individuals in the engineering team to ensure ability to take advantage of new technologies.
Recruit and grow the engineering team as required by the business.

Measurement:
Based on a combination of factors including number of new customer projects successfully deployed, speed of resolution of support issues, training, technical management of a wholesale customer projects etc.
Percentage of projects delivered on time and within budget.
Reduction in deployment time through standardization and automation.
MTTR and severity-1 incident frequency for production platforms.
Percentage of projects transitioned to NOC with complete documentation.
Engineering capacity utilization and delivery predictability.

Required Qualifications:

BS and or MS in Computer/Telecom/Electrical Engineering.
Minimum of 8-12 years working in the mobile telecommunications industry designing, integrating, and managing core networks for wireless carriers/ Mobile Network Operators (MNO), MVNO, etc.
Proven ability to lead and manage people as well as scale engineering teams.
Strong executive communication skills with internal stakeholders, vendors, and partners.
Ability to balance deep technical decision-making with commercial and business outcomes.
Experience delivering solutions for roaming, loT, MVNO, Private Mobile Networks, Non-Terrestrial Networks (NTN).
Strong vendor management and negotiation skills.

Preferred Qualifications:

Entrepreneurial and proactive self-starter with a hunger to make a difference as well as strong performance and results orientation.
Ability to thrive in a fast-paced start-up environment, managing multiple projects and deadlines in parallel with ability to recognize and adjust priorities as required.
Detail-oriented, methodical, and well organized yet able to demonstrate a high degree of flexibility and adaptability.
Ability to work effectively both independently as well as in a team.
Confident, self-motivated, self-directed, and energetic personality.
Strong analytical, problem solving and negotiation skills.
Excellent skills in building and managing relationships as well as influencing.
Excellent communications and presentation skills.
Positive and constructive personality, including willingness to go beyond the call-of-duty to ensure successful and on-time delivery of projects.

$170000.00 -$180000.00 /Year.

jobs.description:
RELOCATION ASSISTANCE: Relocation assistance may be available

CLEARANCE REQUIRED FOR START: Yes

CLEARANCE TYPE: Secret

TRAVEL: Yes, 25% of the Time

Description

At Northrop Grumman, our employees have incredible opportunities to work on revolutionary systems that impact people's lives around the world today, and for generations to come. Our pioneering and inventive spirit has enabled us to be at the forefront of many technological advancements in our nation's history - from the first flight across the Atlantic Ocean, to stealth bombers, to landing on the moon. We look for people who have bold new ideas, courage and a pioneering spirit to join forces to invent the future, and have fun along the way. Our culture thrives on intellectual curiosity, cognitive diversity and bringing your whole self to work — and we have an insatiable drive to do what others think is impossible. Our employees are not only part of history, they're making history.

Northrop Grumman’s Defense Systems sector is looking for a Director for Sentinel Specialty Engineering
within the Strategic Deterrent Systems Division. This position will be located in Roy, Utah or Huntsville, AL
and will support the Sentinel program. Northrop Grumman supports the Air Force’s sustainment, development, production and deployment of hardware and system modifications for Intercontinental Ballistic Missile (ICBM) Ground and Airborne Launch Control Systems, Launch Facilities and associated infrastructure.

What You Will Get To Do

Lead the Specialty Engineering organization within Sentinel Systems Engineering, supporting the Systems Engineering Element Lead.
Direct the implementation of specialty system engineering requirements and processes across the program segments, driving consistency and implementation across program/product teams at all national locations and multiple subcontractor locations.
Management (CAM) of specialty engineering work scope including planning, budgeting, and reporting.
Coordination of specialty engineering topics across various integrated product teams (IPTs).
Leadership and coordination of internal and external stakeholder engagements (engineering review boards, change control boards, customer sync meetings, formal working groups, and others).
Ensuring flow, decomposition, and satisfaction of specialty engineering requirements and design compliance according to Sentinel processes and governance.
Establish and direct the implementation of model-based digital engineering processes used in the design and development of Sentinel, at all levels of decomposition.
Ensure specialty engineering product quality and consistency for the Sentinel program.
Interface closely with the product/program team leadership and implement systems engineering priorities for the team.
Provide technical leadership and oversight for Specialty Engineering (Human Systems Integration, Nuclear Hardness and Survivability, E3, and System Safety) including mentoring high potential leaders and advising program lead

Additional Responsibilities May Include

Horizontally integrate across System Engineering directorate as well as members of the Engineering and Manufacturing Operations organization to ensure consistency of systems engineering approach. This will help identify areas of opportunity to support upcoming challenges that are not currently being elevated.
Provide independent review of portfolio software, hardware and deliverables, focused deep dives in program and product teams, as well as driving compliance to processes and procedures.
Identify opportunities for and support of engagement activities across all programs.
Identify and mentor high potential technical leaders.
Provide advisement to all program leads (as required) and embedded resources.

As a full-time employee of Northrop Grumman Defense Systems, you are eligible for our robust benefits package including:

Medical, Dental & Vision coverage
401k
Educational Assistance
Life Insurance
Employee Assistance Programs & Work/Life Solutions
Paid Time Off
Health & Wellness Resources
Employee Discounts

This positions standard work schedule is a 9/80. The 9/80 schedule allows employees who work a nine-hour day Monday through Thursday to take every other Friday off. This position may offer relocation assistance.

You'll Bring These Qualifications

Bachelor’s Degree in STEM with at least 10 years of progressive engineering experience, or Master’s and 8 years’ of experience.
Experience leading engineering teams/and or organizations to achieve a common goal.
Active US Government Secret clearance, investigation must have been completed within last 5 years

These Qualifications Would Be Nice To Have

ICBM or complex aerospace systems experience
Experience in Human Systems Integration, Nuclear Hardness and Survivability, Electromagnetic Environmental Effects (E3), System Safety, Specialty Integration, and Compliance Requirements/Verification
Model-Based Systems Engineering (MBSE) experience
Design Engineering/Computer-aided Design (CAD) experience
Prior experience interfacing with prime contractor site leads and USAF leadership personnel
Prior experience with Air Force Range Safety
Active DoD TS/SCI clearance
Experience leading the performance of tasks on schedule, at cost and achieving all requirements as either project lead, integrated program team or cost account manager
Demonstrated effectiveness in achieving results through managing people and management of internal processes and customer/supplier relationships.
Strong understanding and broad application of complex engineering systems (engineering standards, configuration management, material review board, process control, tooling, facilities, software, etc.)
Strong oral and written communication skills, including demonstrated experience with high value customer presentations, with ability to focus on multiple projects with competing priorities
Experience in working closely with customers to ensure delivery of systems that meet warfighter needs
Ability to collaborate and achieve consensus when dealing with groups from diverse organizations and backgrounds
Demonstrated experience in making sound decisions in uncertain and difficult situations
Strong sense of urgency and work ethic in ensuring engineering meets customer and program expectations in a timely and efficient manner

Primary Level Salary Range: $193,800.00 - $321,000.00

The above salary range represents a general guideline; however, Northrop Grumman considers a number of factors when determining base salary offers such as the scope and responsibilities of the position and the candidate's experience, education, skills and current market conditions.

Depending on the position, employees may be eligible for overtime, shift differential, and a discretionary bonus in addition to base pay. jobs.title: Director/Managing Director, AI Software Development
jobs.description:
Job Description

As CohnReznick grows, so do our career opportunities. As one of the nation’s top professional services firms, CohnReznick creates rewarding careers in advisory, assurance, and tax with team members who value innovation and collaboration in everything they do!

CohnReznick helps organizations optimize performance, manage risk, and maximize value through CohnReznick LLP (assurance services) and CohnReznick Advisory LLC (advisory and tax services). Together, the firm provides leaders with deep industry knowledge and relationships, solutions to address clients’ unique business goals and risks, and insight on how emerging market forces can drive opportunity. With offices nationwide, the firm serves organizations around the world as an independent member of Nexia.

We currently have an exciting career opportunity for a Director/Managing Director, AI Software Development
to support our Global Digital & CyberSecurity
practice.

CohnReznick is a hybrid firm and most of our professionals are located within a commutable distance to one of our offices. This position is considered remote which means it does not require job duties be performed within proximity of a CohnReznick office location. However, as a remote employee, you may be required to be present at a CohnReznick office with scheduled notice for client work, team meetings, or trainings.

YOUR TEAM.

The Director / Managing Director, AI Software Development is a senior technology leader responsible for establishing and leading CohnReznick's software engineering capability. This position defines the vision, strategy, operating model, talent plan, architecture, and delivery approach for AI-enabled products, platforms, and solutions across the firm.

The position is accountable for building a high-performing AI-native software development organization capable of delivering proprietary technology assets that create sustainable competitive advantage. The leader oversees the design, development, deployment, and operation of AI-powered applications, intelligent automation solutions, agentic workflows, and client-facing digital products.

This is not a traditional application-development leadership role. The successful candidate must have personally built and scaled a native AI software team from inception through production delivery, including recruiting specialized talent, establishing engineering and governance standards, and delivering secure applications with measurable business impact.

WHY COHNREZNICK?

At CohnReznick, we’re united by a common mission to create opportunity, value, and trust for our clients, our people, and our communities. Whether it’s working alongside your peers to solve a client challenge, or volunteering together at the local food bank, there are so many ways to find your “why” at the firm.

We believe it’s important to balance work with everyday life – and make time for enjoyment and fun. We invest in a robust Total Rewards package that includes everything from generous PTO, a flexible work environment, expanded parental leave, extensive learning & development, and even paid time off for employees to volunteer.

YOUR ROLE.

Responsibilities Include But Not Limited To

AI strategy and portfolio leadership

Define and execute a multi-year AI software engineering strategy aligned with firm business and technology objectives.
Establish the vision, roadmap, investment priorities, and operating model for the GDC AI development capability.
Identify opportunities to create proprietary software assets that improve client service, quality, efficiency, growth, and professional experience.
Advise executive leaders and governance forums on opportunities, investments, risks, dependencies, and portfolio performance.

Native AI organization building

Recruit, organize, develop, and retain a multidisciplinary team of AI engineers, software engineers, machine learning engineers, technical leads, and architects.
Define job architecture, role expectations, career paths, leadership spans, technical communities, and talent-development practices for the AI engineering function.
Create an engineering culture centered on innovation, responsible experimentation, accountability, inclusion, collaboration, and disciplined production delivery.
Build a sustainable talent pipeline and develop future engineering leaders.

Product and solution delivery

Lead AI-enabled products, platforms, and solutions from discovery and architecture through engineering, release, adoption, operation, and continuous improvement.
Partner with Product Management and business stakeholders to translate strategic priorities into sequenced, funded, and measurable delivery commitments.
Manage execution across concurrent initiatives while balancing value, speed, quality, security, risk, reliability, and maintainability.
Establish outcome, delivery, quality, adoption, and operational measures; use results to improve priorities and execution.

Architecture, engineering, and operations

Establish development standards, reference architectures, engineering frameworks, reusable components, testing practices, and technical quality controls.
Define patterns for large language model integration, agentic systems, retrieval-augmented generation, intelligent workflow automation, observability, evaluation, and model operations.
Implement modern cloud-native engineering, DevSecOps, CI/CD, API, integration, reliability, incident-management, and lifecycle-management practices.
Promote reuse, platform leverage, technical-debt management, and reduction of unnecessary technology redundancy.

Governance, risk, and stakeholder leadership

Embed security, privacy, legal, regulatory, records-management, data-governance, and responsible AI requirements throughout the development lifecycle.
Partner with Enterprise Architecture, Information Security, Data & Analytics, Risk, Legal, and other control functions to govern design and deployment decisions.
Communicate complex technical matters in clear business terms and build trusted relationships with executives, professionals, clients, vendors, and strategic partners.
Drive adoption, change leadership, knowledge transfer, and transparent reporting of progress, risks, decisions, and realized value.

The duties listed are intended to describe the general nature and level of work performed. They are not an exhaustive list of every responsibility, duty, or skill required. Responsibilities may change based on business needs.

Your Experience.

The successful candidate will have:

Education And Experience

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.
Fifteen or more years of progressive software engineering and technology leadership experience.
Seven or more years leading software development organizations, including leaders of engineering teams.
Five or more years delivering AI-enabled applications, machine learning platforms, intelligent automation solutions, or generative AI products.
Demonstrated success creating and scaling a native AI software development organization that moved beyond pilots and experimentation to secure, production-grade solutions.
Proven delivery of enterprise-grade software products and platforms in complex, regulated, or high-trust environments.
Experience leading geographically distributed teams and a blended workforce of employees, contractors, and strategic partners.

Technical and delivery expertise

Generative AI, large language models, agentic architectures, retrieval-augmented generation, AI evaluation, observability, and model operations.
Cloud-native software development, enterprise application architecture, APIs, integration patterns, data platforms, and analytics ecosystems.
DevSecOps, CI/CD, automated testing, software supply-chain controls, production reliability, and secure development lifecycle practices.
Responsible AI, AI governance, privacy, security, model risk, data governance, and human oversight.
Product-oriented delivery using measurable outcomes, iterative development, user feedback, adoption measures, and value realization.

Preferred Qualifications

Advanced degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Business, or a related field.
Leadership experience in professional services, financial services, regulated industries, or enterprise B2B software.
Experience with Microsoft Azure AI, Azure OpenAI, Microsoft Copilot technologies, and modern AI engineering frameworks.
Relevant credentials in AI, cloud architecture, software engineering, cybersecurity, or product delivery.
Experience commercializing proprietary software or creating client-facing digital products and technology-enabled services.

In addition, please take a moment to review our Universal Job Standards.

Studies have shown that we are less likely to apply to jobs unless we meet every single qualification. At CohnReznick, we are dedicated to building a diverse, equitable, and inclusive workplace, so if you’re excited about this role but your experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we still encourage you to apply. You may be just the right candidate for this or one of our other roles.

Salary is one component of the CohnReznick total rewards package, which includes a discretionary performance bonus, generous paid time off, expanded and inclusive parental benefits, and access to best-in-class learning and development platforms, to name a few. jobs.title: Director/Managing Director, AI Software Development
jobs.description:
Job Description

As CohnReznick grows, so do our career opportunities. As one of the nation’s top professional services firms, CohnReznick creates rewarding careers in advisory, assurance, and tax with team members who value innovation and collaboration in everything they do!

CohnReznick helps organizations optimize performance, manage risk, and maximize value through CohnReznick LLP (assurance services) and CohnReznick Advisory LLC (advisory and tax services). Together, the firm provides leaders with deep industry knowledge and relationships, solutions to address clients’ unique business goals and risks, and insight on how emerging market forces can drive opportunity. With offices nationwide, the firm serves organizations around the world as an independent member of Nexia.

We currently have an exciting career opportunity for a Director/Managing Director, AI Software Development
to support our Global Digital & CyberSecurity
practice.

CohnReznick is a hybrid firm and most of our professionals are located within a commutable distance to one of our offices. This position is considered remote which means it does not require job duties be performed within proximity of a CohnReznick office location. However, as a remote employee, you may be required to be present at a CohnReznick office with scheduled notice for client work, team meetings, or trainings.

YOUR TEAM.

The Director / Managing Director, AI Software Development is a senior technology leader responsible for establishing and leading CohnReznick's software engineering capability. This position defines the vision, strategy, operating model, talent plan, architecture, and delivery approach for AI-enabled products, platforms, and solutions across the firm.

The position is accountable for building a high-performing AI-native software development organization capable of delivering proprietary technology assets that create sustainable competitive advantage. The leader oversees the design, development, deployment, and operation of AI-powered applications, intelligent automation solutions, agentic workflows, and client-facing digital products.

This is not a traditional application-development leadership role. The successful candidate must have personally built and scaled a native AI software team from inception through production delivery, including recruiting specialized talent, establishing engineering and governance standards, and delivering secure applications with measurable business impact.

WHY COHNREZNICK?

At CohnReznick, we’re united by a common mission to create opportunity, value, and trust for our clients, our people, and our communities. Whether it’s working alongside your peers to solve a client challenge, or volunteering together at the local food bank, there are so many ways to find your “why” at the firm.

We believe it’s important to balance work with everyday life – and make time for enjoyment and fun. We invest in a robust Total Rewards package that includes everything from generous PTO, a flexible work environment, expanded parental leave, extensive learning & development, and even paid time off for employees to volunteer.

YOUR ROLE.

Responsibilities Include But Not Limited To

AI strategy and portfolio leadership

Define and execute a multi-year AI software engineering strategy aligned with firm business and technology objectives.
Establish the vision, roadmap, investment priorities, and operating model for the GDC AI development capability.
Identify opportunities to create proprietary software assets that improve client service, quality, efficiency, growth, and professional experience.
Advise executive leaders and governance forums on opportunities, investments, risks, dependencies, and portfolio performance.

Native AI organization building

Recruit, organize, develop, and retain a multidisciplinary team of AI engineers, software engineers, machine learning engineers, technical leads, and architects.
Define job architecture, role expectations, career paths, leadership spans, technical communities, and talent-development practices for the AI engineering function.
Create an engineering culture centered on innovation, responsible experimentation, accountability, inclusion, collaboration, and disciplined production delivery.
Build a sustainable talent pipeline and develop future engineering leaders.

Product and solution delivery

Lead AI-enabled products, platforms, and solutions from discovery and architecture through engineering, release, adoption, operation, and continuous improvement.
Partner with Product Management and business stakeholders to translate strategic priorities into sequenced, funded, and measurable delivery commitments.
Manage execution across concurrent initiatives while balancing value, speed, quality, security, risk, reliability, and maintainability.
Establish outcome, delivery, quality, adoption, and operational measures; use results to improve priorities and execution.

Architecture, engineering, and operations

Establish development standards, reference architectures, engineering frameworks, reusable components, testing practices, and technical quality controls.
Define patterns for large language model integration, agentic systems, retrieval-augmented generation, intelligent workflow automation, observability, evaluation, and model operations.
Implement modern cloud-native engineering, DevSecOps, CI/CD, API, integration, reliability, incident-management, and lifecycle-management practices.
Promote reuse, platform leverage, technical-debt management, and reduction of unnecessary technology redundancy.

Governance, risk, and stakeholder leadership

Embed security, privacy, legal, regulatory, records-management, data-governance, and responsible AI requirements throughout the development lifecycle.
Partner with Enterprise Architecture, Information Security, Data & Analytics, Risk, Legal, and other control functions to govern design and deployment decisions.
Communicate complex technical matters in clear business terms and build trusted relationships with executives, professionals, clients, vendors, and strategic partners.
Drive adoption, change leadership, knowledge transfer, and transparent reporting of progress, risks, decisions, and realized value.

The duties listed are intended to describe the general nature and level of work performed. They are not an exhaustive list of every responsibility, duty, or skill required. Responsibilities may change based on business needs.

Your Experience.

The successful candidate will have:

Education And Experience

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.
Fifteen or more years of progressive software engineering and technology leadership experience.
Seven or more years leading software development organizations, including leaders of engineering teams.
Five or more years delivering AI-enabled applications, machine learning platforms, intelligent automation solutions, or generative AI products.
Demonstrated success creating and scaling a native AI software development organization that moved beyond pilots and experimentation to secure, production-grade solutions.
Proven delivery of enterprise-grade software products and platforms in complex, regulated, or high-trust environments.
Experience leading geographically distributed teams and a blended workforce of employees, contractors, and strategic partners.

Technical and delivery expertise

Generative AI, large language models, agentic architectures, retrieval-augmented generation, AI evaluation, observability, and model operations.
Cloud-native software development, enterprise application architecture, APIs, integration patterns, data platforms, and analytics ecosystems.
DevSecOps, CI/CD, automated testing, software supply-chain controls, production reliability, and secure development lifecycle practices.
Responsible AI, AI governance, privacy, security, model risk, data governance, and human oversight.
Product-oriented delivery using measurable outcomes, iterative development, user feedback, adoption measures, and value realization.

Preferred Qualifications

Advanced degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Business, or a related field.
Leadership experience in professional services, financial services, regulated industries, or enterprise B2B software.
Experience with Microsoft Azure AI, Azure OpenAI, Microsoft Copilot technologies, and modern AI engineering frameworks.
Relevant credentials in AI, cloud architecture, software engineering, cybersecurity, or product delivery.
Experience commercializing proprietary software or creating client-facing digital products and technology-enabled services.

In addition, please take a moment to review our Universal Job Standards.

Studies have shown that we are less likely to apply to jobs unless we meet every single qualification. At CohnReznick, we are dedicated to building a diverse, equitable, and inclusive workplace, so if you’re excited about this role but your experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we still encourage you to apply. You may be just the right candidate for this or one of our other roles.

jobs.title: Director, Platform Engineering
jobs.description:
Accelerate your career. Join the organization that's driving the world's technology and shape the future.

Ingram Micro is a leading technology company for the global information technology ecosystem. With the ability to reach nearly 90% of the global population, we play a vital role in the worldwide IT sales channel, bringing products and services from technology manufacturers and cloud providers to business-to-business technology experts. Our market reach, diverse solutions and services portfolio, and digital platform Ingram Micro Xvantage™ set us apart. Learn more at www.ingrammicro.com.

Come join our team where you’ll make technology happen in surprising ways. Let’s shape tomorrow - it’ll be a fun journey!

Ingram Micro is seeking a Director, Platform Engineering to own both the day-to-day operational health of our technology platform and the long-term transformation of how we build, release, and run software. This is a dual-mandate leadership role: keep the lights on and evolve what those lights look like.

This role sits within the Global Platform Technology organization, part of the broader CTO organization. The Director will report directly into the Executive Director, Agile Delivery & Program Management, who leads the full cross-functional technology enablement portfolio alongside Engineering. This structure ensures the role is tightly connected to both engineering execution and the broader operational and delivery agenda.

The Director will lead four core disciplines; SRE, DevOps, Performance Engineering, and Release Management, with a clear, unifying transformation agenda: replace manual processes with intelligent automation, embed AI across every operational function, and build a technology operations organization that is self-sufficient, preventive, and scalable. The answer to operational complexity is not more people, it is smarter systems.

Your role:

THE DUAL MANDATE

RUN: Day-to-Day Operations - Own the operational stability, reliability, and performance of the platform. Ensure SRE, DevOps, release, and performance functions deliver consistently against SLOs, release cadences, and quality benchmarks.
TRANSFORM: AI & Automation Agenda - Lead the transformation of all four disciplines into AI-powered, self-serve functions — where automation handles the routine, AI anticipates the unexpected, and engineers focus on outcomes rather than operations.

What you’ll lead and transform:

Site Reliability Engineering (SRE)

Implement AI-powered predictive monitoring and anomaly detection to surface degradation signals before they become incidents.
Build automated remediation, self-healing infrastructure, AI-triggered rollbacks, and automated runbook execution, to resolve issues without human intervention.
Shift the SRE model from reactive firefighting to proactive reliability engineering, using AI insights to eliminate recurring failure patterns.
Govern SLIs, SLOs, and error budgets as the framework for reliability investment, with real-time AI forecasting of compliance.
Embed reliability thinking early in the engineering lifecycle — shifting reliability left, not bolting it on at the end.

DevOps

Design and execute an AI-driven CI/CD strategy targeting 100% touchless, end-to-end pipeline automation, zero manual intervention from commit to production.
Embed AI across the pipeline for intelligent code analysis, automated testing, self-healing deployments, and anomaly detection.
Architect and deliver self-serve developer platforms that empower teams to provision environments, trigger deployments, and manage releases independently.
Define milestones and metrics for the automation roadmap, tracking progress toward full pipeline autonomy.
Champion a culture of engineering self-sufficiency, reducing toil and enabling teams to ship faster with greater confidence.

Performance Engineering

Own load, stress, and scalability testing programs, ensuring the platform performs reliably under current and projected demand.
Automate performance testing as a continuous activity within CI/CD pipelines, blocking releases that regress against defined baselines.
Use AI to identify performance bottlenecks, forecast capacity needs, and recommend optimizations before issues surface in production.
Drive FinOps practices to optimize cloud resource utilization and infrastructure spend alongside performance improvements.

Release Management

Own the end-to-end release process across environments, ensuring consistency, auditability, and minimal disruption to production.
Automate release orchestration, approval workflows, and deployment coordination to reduce manual overhead and human error.
Implement AI-assisted release risk scoring to evaluate change impact, recommend optimal deployment windows, and flag high-risk releases before they go out.
Establish feedback loops between release outcomes and development practices to continuously reduce change failure rates.

People and Organizational Leadership

Lead a team of leaders and associates spanning SRE, DevOps, performance, and release functions.
Build a high-performing, transformation-minded organization that is as focused on evolving how they work as on the work itself.
Set clear goals, accountability structures, and transformation milestones across all four disciplines.
Partner cross-functionally with engineering, product, and platform teams to ensure operational and delivery excellence.

What you bring to the role:

Bachelor’s Degree required in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related field required; MBA or Master’s degree preferred.
Minimum of 8-10 years of relevant experience
Proven leadership experience across SRE, DevOps, performance engineering, and/or release management at a director level or equivalent.
A clear track record of transformation, not just running these functions, but fundamentally changing how they operate through automation and AI.
Hands-on experience applying AI and ML to operational domains — predictive monitoring, automated remediation, intelligent pipelines, or risk-based release management.
Deep expertise in CI/CD design, infrastructure automation, and building self-serve developer platforms.
Experience evolving SRE toward prevention-first, AI-driven reliability models — including predictive anomaly detection and automated incident resolution.
Strong understanding of observability principles, SLIs, SLOs, error budgets, logging, metrics, and distributed tracing.
Experience with cloud infrastructure management, FinOps practices, and cost optimization at scale.
Excellent stakeholder management and cross-functional collaboration skills.
Strong people leadership, with the ability to build and inspire teams through significant organizational change.
Experience in a large-scale, global technology organization is a strong advantage.

The typical base pay range for this role across the U.S. is USD $171,300.00 - $299,800.00 per year.

The ranges above reflect the potential annual base pay across the U.S. for all roles; the applicable base pay range will depend on the candidate’s primary work location, pay grade, and variable compensation plan. Individual base pay within each range depends on various factors, in addition to primary work location, such as complexity and responsibility of role, job duties/requirements, and relevant experience and skills. Base pay ranges are reviewed and typically updated each year. Offers are made within the base pay range applicable at the time of hire. New hires starting base pay generally falls in the bottom half (between the minimum and midpoint) of a pay range.

At Ingram Micro certain roles are eligible for additional rewards, including merit increases, annual bonus or sales incentives and long-term incentives. These awards are allocated based on position level and individual performance. U.S.-based employees have access to healthcare benefits, paid time off, parental leave, a 401(k) plan and company match, short-term and long-term disability coverage, basic life insurance, and wellbeing benefits, among others.

This is not a complete listing of the job duties. It’s a representation of the things you will be doing, and you may not perform all these duties.

Please be prepared to pass a drug test and successfully pass a pre-employment (post offer) background check.

Ingram Micro Inc. is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, veteran status, or any other protected category under applicable law.

jobs.title: Head of Forward Deployed Engineering
jobs.description:
About Cape

Cape is America’s privacy-first mobile carrier. Our mission is to be a force for good in global wireless. Cape was founded in 2022 by people who believe privacy is a fundamental right, not a luxury to be traded away. Our journey began when our founder recognized a critical vulnerability in our modern world: everyone relies on the same stagnant cellular infrastructure and legacy systems that track our every movement, monitor and profile our connections, and lose and sell our personal data.

Instead of accepting the status quo, we decided to fix it. National security professionals, journalists, parents, and everyone in between can stay connected and have privacy.

We didn’t just build a layer on top of old tech; we built America’s most private and secure mobile carrier from the ground up. By building our own network from scratch, we are able to design and build a suite of privacy and security features that no other carrier on the planet can offer.

Today, Cape provides our secure network to consumers, businesses, and government agencies alike. We closed our Series C in March 2026, and we are scaling rapidly, with the goal of giving people back control of their most personal information.

The Team

At Cape, we are the architects of a privacy-centric movement that is just getting started. We are relentless builders, constantly innovating at the edge of what's possible in telecommunications. We operate on a foundation of high trust and high expectations. Our structure is flat, and collaboration matters more than hierarchy. As a member of our team, you will collaborate with world-class engineers, architects, and visionaries, and work across organizational lines to solve "impossible" problems and deliver mission-critical results for our users every single day.

The Problem

The commercial cellular network represents trillions of dollars in private investment worldwide. It is performant, highly available, near ubiquitous, and the spec is mature and well understood. It’s the perfect transport layer for government use cases, if only they could trust the network. But they cannot: that infrastructure is easily disrupted and surveilled, and existing solutions are typically clunky, proprietary, and fail at the first sign of a contested RF environment.

Cape started at first principles to build a secure network architecture that operates through assumed compromised physical infrastructure. Now we need to solve operational capabilities at scale. How do we provide security-first, resilient communications for operators at the tactical edge? How do we ensure connectivity without compromise when the backhaul is being actively jammed, intercepted, or physically severed?

We are moving from validated technology to mission-critical infrastructure
that works in contested environments when failure is not an option. Leading this team of engineers is a high stakes, critical role and will be deeply rewarding for the right person.

The Role

Cape’s platform gives customers end-to-end control of their digital identity, even as they connect to untrusted networks, optimizing for resiliency, privacy, and security at every turn. As the Head of Federal Engineering, you will gain rare insight into the world’s most challenging environments. You will own the technical execution of the federal business, partnering with Business Development and Product to bridge the gap between our core technology and the specific, demanding requirements of our government partners.

You will cultivate a high-performing technical team, providing the mentorship needed to deliver outcomes in highly regulated spaces. Your charge is to grow the business and empower your engineers to work autonomously in remote locations, making great technical decisions to build the most overlooked yet critical components of modern Command and Control (C2)--the transport layer.

What You'll Work On

Architect and execute the technical vision for our federal engineering organization, building the secure, resilient, and scalable network and platform that our nation's most critical missions depend on. Your leadership will directly translate our privacy-first ethos into capabilities that protect and empower those in public service.
Lead, mentor, and inspire a world-class team of engineers dedicated to solving the nation's toughest Command and Control challenges. You will foster a culture of innovation, collaboration, and unwavering integrity, empowering your team to deliver solutions that meet the highest standards of excellence and impact.
Serve as the key technical partner to our federal customers, translating their complex mission requirements into tangible, deployed solutions. You will build and nurture deep relationships, ensuring that we are not just a vendor, but a trusted partner in advancing national security and public trust.
Take complete ownership and serve as the technical owner for our federal customers. You will ensure that our engineering practices, security protocols, and delivery timelines set a new standard for what is possible in government technology.
Steer our engagement with the unique challenges and opportunities of the federal landscape. You will be the bridge between our core technology and the specific, demanding requirements of our government partners, ensuring our solutions are always at the vanguard of innovation and mission-ready.

What We Value

Proven ability to learn continuously, work independently, and make decisions with minimal supervision.
A belief that the best leaders empower their teams to achieve the impossible. You are a mentor and a force-multiplier, dedicated to growing the next generation of engineering leaders and fostering a culture where every individual can do their best work in service of the mission.
The ability to take a thoughtful, practical approach to problem-solving that considers tradeoffs and avoids over-engineering.
Skill and comfort working in a constantly evolving environment with dynamic objectives and iteration with users.
The ability to work collaboratively in teams of technical and non-technical individuals and understand how technical decisions impact the customer.
Understanding of cryptographic systems and how to design privacy conscious solutions.
The ability to learn new technology and concepts, even without in-depth experience.
The ability to balance a forward-looking vision with the concrete realities of government requirements and constraints. You find creative yet practical paths to deploy modern technology within highly regulated environments, ensuring solutions are not just innovative, but also accreditable and effective.
You are more than a technical leader; you are a diplomat and a strategist. You excel at building strong, collaborative relationships with government partners and internal stakeholders, translating mission needs into technical reality with clarity and conviction.

Experience

Engineering background in Computer Science, Mathematics, Computer Engineering, Physics or similar field.
Demonstrated success leading engineering teams that have built, deployed, and sustained software solutions for U.S. government, defense, or intelligence community customers.
Understanding of modern software architecture, particularly for secure, scalable, and distributed systems. Experience with both cloud (e.g., AWS GovCloud, Azure Government) as well as air-gapped environments, and familiarity with federal security compliance standards (e.g., FedRAMP, RMF, STIGs) is helpful.
Proven ability to define a technical strategy and execute against it, aligning engineering efforts with both customer mission objectives and broader business goals.
The ability to articulate complex technical concepts with authority and clarity to a wide range of audiences, from your own engineers to senior government officials and non-technical stakeholders.
An active U.S. Top Secret (TS) security clearance is strongly preferred. At a minimum, you must have the ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. security clearance.

Compensation

We offer competitive compensation that is geo-adjusted
based on your location
, along with meaningful equity so you share in the value you help create. Salary range for this role in New York, New York is $200,000-$275,000 depending on experience and interview performance.

Our benefits include:

401(k) match
100% coverage of medical, dental, and vision premiums for you and your dependents
12 weeks paid parental leave (for all parents, no waiting period)
Stipends for
Family-forming needs
Gender-affirming care

Our Culture & Values

We hire excellent people, give them outsized responsibility, and trust them to execute. Every person at Cape has a proven track record of tackling hard problems and winning.
We believe that personal privacy and national security are not at odds, and that they can be reconciled through strong technology.
We believe companies exist to build awesome things and take care of the people who build them, so we offer top-tier healthcare, 401(k) matching, and a generous vacation policy that our team actually uses to recharge.
We believe that a stronger company and a better product are built by people from all walks of life. We hire without regard to race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, marital status, disability, or Veteran status. If you are great at what you do, you belong here.

How To Apply

Click the link below to apply.

Your Team Responsibilities

The Engineering Fellow is an executive-level technical leadership role at MSCI, reporting to the Chief Technology Officer. This role is responsible for the end-to-end technology strategy, architectural blueprint, and engineering excellence at MSCI. The position blends high-level business strategy with hands-on technical governance to deliver highly scalable, secure, and AI-native financial platforms used by clients across the globe.

Your Key Responsibilities

Technology Strategy & Architecture
Architectural Blueprinting: Define and drive the long-term, durable technical architecture for all Product and Business lines at MSCI.
AI-Native Transformation: Spearhead the integration of advanced technologies like Generative AI and machine learning directly into core products and client experiences to benefit clients.
Cloud & Platform Evolution: Oversee the migration, scaling, and cost optimization of high-availability cloud-native solutions.
Technical Governance: Establish design systems, guardrails, and quality frameworks to evaluate solution designs, identify capability gaps, and manage architectural risks.
Engineering & Operational Excellence
Developer Velocity: Champion Agentic Engineering, infrastructure improvements and developer tools that eliminate engineering friction, fostering “speed as a habit” across global teams.
Resiliency & Scalability: Ensure zero-downtime, sub-second latency, and robust disaster recovery capabilities for critical products.
Data Privacy & Compliance: Work closely with security teams to ensure systems are fully compliant with global regulations and data privacy laws.
Leadership & Talent Management
Talent Stewardship: Act as a primary mentor and coach for the organization’s highest technical talent, including Distinguished Engineers, Principal Engineers, and Enterprise Architects.
Boundaryless Collaboration: Partner with cross-functional executive stakeholders—including Product Management, Experience Design (XD), and Data Science—to align technology investments with business growth targets.
M&A Integration: Drive technical due diligence and lead the architectural integration of acquired platforms and third-party independent software vendor (ISV) ecosystems into MSCI Product lines.

Your Skills And Experience That Will Help You Excel

Experience: 15+ years of software product development experience with a strong track record of delivering enterprise-grade platforms at scale.
Leadership: 3–5+ years in an executive-level leadership role managing and coaching globally distributed engineering and architecture teams.
Technical Expertise: Deep expertise across the entire full-stack software development lifecycle—specifically cloud infrastructure, distributed data stores, transactional APIs, financial security compliance, and AI/ML data frameworks.
Education: Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or an equivalent technical field (an MBA or relevant advanced engineering degree is highly preferred).
Domain Expertise: Knowledge of Financial Services is preferred.

About MSCI

What we offer you

Salary range: $375,000 - $475,000 / year, plus eligible for annual bonus
Transparent compensation schemes and comprehensive employee benefits, tailored to your location, ensuring your financial security, health, and overall wellbeing.
Flexible working arrangements, advanced technology, and collaborative workspaces.
A culture of high performance and innovation where we experiment with new ideas and take responsibility for achieving results.
A global network of talented colleagues, who inspire, support, and share their expertise to innovate and deliver for our clients.
Global Orientation program to kickstart your journey, followed by access to our Learning@MSCI platform, AI Learning Center, LinkedIn Learning Pro and tailored learning opportunities for ongoing skills development.
Multi-directional career paths that offer professional growth and development through new challenges, internal mobility and expanded roles.
We actively nurture an environment that builds a sense of inclusion belonging and connection, including eight Employee Resource Groups. All Abilities, Asian Support Network, Black Leadership Network, Climate Action Network, Hola! MSCI, Pride & Allies, Women in Tech, and Women’s Leadership Forum.

At MSCI we are passionate about what we do, and we are inspired by our vision – to power better decisions. You’ll be part of an industry-leading network of creative, curious, and entrepreneurial pioneers. This is a space where you can challenge yourself, set new standards and perform beyond expectations for yourself, our clients, and our industry.

MSCI strengthens global markets by connecting participants across the financial ecosystem with a common language. Our research-based data, analytics and indexes, supported by advanced technology, set standards for global investors and help our clients understand risks and opportunities so they can make better decisions and unlock innovation. We serve asset managers and owners, private-market sponsors and investors, hedge funds, wealth managers, banks, insurers and corporates.

Overview

We are seeking a seasoned Director of Data Engineering to lead and scale a high-performing, enterprise-grade data engineering organization for a healthcare company with petabytes of data. This role is responsible for architecting and governing the data infrastructure and drive the technical roadmap across foundational infrastructure, streaming pipelines, analytics engineering, and AI enablement, and serve as a strategic partner to product, analytics, clinical informatics, and technology leadership

Responsibilities

Oversee the data engineering efforts in ensuring that Cotiviti is able to provision scalable, reliable data pipelines from the various backend data sources to the cloud platform, applying best-in-class cloud-native technologies (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and modern frameworks including Spark, Kafka, dbt, Databricks, and the Cloudera/Hadoop ecosystem.
Lead and manage a team of data engineers in delivering quality code and building data products and use cases, fostering a culture of engineering excellence, accountability, and continuous improvement across multiple functional squads.
Ensure the organization follows best practices in data architecture and engineering standards so that pipelines are established with reusable, scalable engineering patterns aligned to data mesh principles and enterprise platform engineering.
Influence the vision for the data engineering platform in creating data products that power multiple use cases and projects — including AI/ML use cases, Analytics and BI use cases, and LLM-powered Agentic use cases — collaborating closely with Architecture and Product Management teams to shape the data product roadmap.
Establish a metrics- and KPIs-driven approach to measure the work done by the data engineering team, track business value of data products created, and monitor, measure, and continuously improve team performance and throughput.
Influence solution architecture of AI/ML and Agentic AI solutions , collaborating with Data Science, Product, and line-of-business teams to ensure data infrastructure is AI-ready, including feature store availability, embedding pipelines, vector databases, and real-time serving capabilities.
Ideate and lead Proof of Concepts and MVPs that advance Cotiviti's data engineering posture in the rapidly evolving landscape of AI, generative AI, and agentic systems.
Identify and monitor key business risks related to realizing the data needs of the business, communicating risks and mitigation strategies proactively to VP- and C-suite stakeholders.
Evangelize strong data engineering patterns and practices throughout the organization by communicating the vision and use cases of advanced analytics, data products, and AI-enabled capabilities to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Hire, develop, coach, lead, and retain top-tier talent , with a focus on building and improving a team and culture that employs best-in-class practices to drive high levels of internal and external customer satisfaction.
Complete all responsibilities as outlined in the annual performance review and/or goal setting.
Complete all special projects and other duties as assigned.
Must be able to perform duties with or without reasonable accommodation.

This job description is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed and is not to be construed as an exhaustive list of responsibilities, duties and skills required. This job description does not constitute an employment agreement and is subject to change as the needs of Cotiviti and requirements of the job change.

Qualifications

Bachelor's degree and 12+ of professional experience required in a data engineering, analytical, or information specialist role within a corporate or consulting setting; experience in healthcare, life sciences, or a related industry strongly preferred
Deep understanding of data engineering architectures, technologies, and platforms focused on large-scale data management and AI applications, including cloud-native platforms such as Databricks, GCP, and AWS, as well as the Cloudera/Hadoop ecosystem
Strong foundation and point of view on generative AI techniques like LLMs and Agentic architectures in solving data engineering problems
Proven expertise in designing and implementing enterprise data architectures on cloud platforms, with hands-on fluency in ETL/ELT, data modeling, data integration, and the modern data stack (Spark, dbt, Kafka, Airflow)
Deep understanding of data governance, data quality, and data security best practices , including HIPAA compliance and handling of sensitive healthcare and claims data in a discretionary manner
Strong foundation and clear point of view on generative AI techniques — including LLMs and Agentic architectures — and how they apply to solving data engineering problems at enterprise scale
Demonstrated ability to solve complex business problems by creating scalable data products that surface insights from both structured and unstructured data, including the ability to create examples, prototypes, and demonstrations that help leadership better understand the work
Proven ability to lead and manage large data engineering teams (15+ Data engineers), including hiring, developing, coaching, and retaining top-tier talent with a focus on high performance and customer satisfaction
Proficiency at planning and setting meaningful objectives aligned to organizational goals; ability to articulate, promote, and implement strategic plans while managing multiple concurrent projects, shifting priorities, and firm deadlines
Exceptional written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills with the ability to identify and articulate business challenges, project objectives, and engineering approaches to both technical and non-technical audiences, including executive stakeholders
Strong initiative, self-motivation, and ability to work autonomously while also leading and collaborating within large cross-functional teams in a customer-service-oriented environment

Problem-solving and thinking critically.
Completing tasks independently.
Interpreting data.
Maintaining focus.

Remaining in a stationary position, often standing or sitting for prolonged periods.
Repeating motions that may include the wrists, hands and/or fingers.

Cotiviti offers team members a competitive benefits package to address a wide range of personal and family needs, including medical, dental, vision, disability, and life insurance coverage, 401(k) savings plans, paid family leave, 9 paid holidays per year, and 17-27 days of Paid Time Off (PTO) per year, depending on specific level and length of service with Cotiviti. For information about our benefits package, please refer to our Careers page.
