jobs.description:
Job Description:

Building trusted markets — powered by our people

At Cboe Global Markets, we inspire our people to solve complex challenges together because what we do matters. We provide the financial infrastructure that powers the global economy. As a leading provider of market infrastructure and tradable products, Cboe delivers cutting-edge trading, clearing and investment solutions to market participants around the world. 

We’re building meaningful ways to support professional and personal development while strengthening the trust we’ve earned as a global market leader. Our teams are empowered to share ideas, actively pursue them and bring on a challenge. As champions of internal mobility and access to opportunity, we encourage our people to “go for it” and equip our managers with the training to coach their teams to the next level. We strive to provide employees a safe space to network, share ideas and create opportunities.  

To support strong partnership and team connection, this role follows a four day in office work model.

Role Overview

The Sr. Manager of Network Engineering is a senior technical leader responsible for leading a high-performing network engineering team that designs, builds, and operates the low-latency infrastructure supporting Cboe’s global financial exchange platforms. This role sits at the intersection of hands-on technical depth and strategic execution, ensuring the network consistently meets the performance, reliability, and determinism required for global markets.

Cboe’s network directly underpins market integrity and fairness, requiring expert-level understanding of low-latency architecture, routing design, and the practical limitations of network hardware and software platforms. This is not a generalist leadership role—technical credibility and the ability to guide engineers through complex, research-driven design and implementation work is essential. The Sr. Manager is expected to operate independently, own outcomes end-to-end, and align engineering efforts to key business and market initiatives with a strong “make it happen” mindset.

The team is responsible for a broad and evolving network footprint, including low-latency trading infrastructure, global WAN/MPLS, hybrid cloud connectivity, remote office networking, network authentication, packet capture and timestamping systems, and automation tooling. The Sr. Manager works closely with Network Operations and Security teams to provide escalation support, drive resolution of complex issues, and ensure seamless collaboration across infrastructure domains.

Success in this role requires the ability to lead in a fast-paced, highly dynamic environment with shifting priorities and parallel workstreams. The Sr. Manager serves as a technical authority, mentor, and decision-maker—setting direction, establishing best practices, and driving execution across both strategic projects and day-to-day operations. Strong communication skills are critical, including the ability to clearly articulate technical risks, trade-offs, and priorities to senior leadership while maintaining alignment across engineering teams.

Your responsibilities will be:

Lead, mentor, and develop a high-performing network engineering team, fostering technical excellence, strong accountability, and disciplined engineering practices across a global, multi-region environment
Drive strategic network initiatives from concept through execution, including pre-implementation research, design validation, vendor evaluation, and production deployment, ensuring high-quality delivery and strong execution discipline
Own the architecture and long-term evolution of low-latency trading network infrastructure, guiding design decisions around topology, routing, performance optimization, and scalability in environments where latency and determinism are critical
Partner closely with senior technical contributors, including Principal Engineers, to lead complex design efforts, validate architectural decisions, and raise the overall technical bar of the organization
Manage a dynamic project portfolio, continuously reprioritizing work based on business needs, market events, and operational risk while maintaining alignment to key strategic initiatives
Collaborate across infrastructure, security, cloud, and application teams to deliver integrated solutions, ensuring reliable, secure, and high-performance connectivity across all environments
Establish and enforce strong operational practices, including structured change management, validation procedures, incident response expectations, and post-implementation review processes
Support and influence network automation strategy, encouraging scalable, maintainable approaches using Python and API-driven tooling to improve efficiency and reduce operational friction
Oversee vendor relationships and hardware/software evaluation efforts, including participation in RFPs, proof-of-concept testing, and critical design reviews, ensuring informed technology decisions
Serve as a senior escalation point for complex network issues, leading high-impact troubleshooting efforts and ensuring timely resolution across engineering and operations teams
Contribute to budgeting and capacity planning for network infrastructure, aligning investments with performance requirements and business growth
Define and maintain engineering standards, architecture documentation, and technical processes, including contributions to regulatory-facing documentation where required
Operate effectively in a fast-paced, evolving environment, balancing long-term architectural direction with immediate operational priorities and driving a strong “make it happen” execution mindset

The ideal candidate has

10+ years of progressive network engineering experience in low-latency, mission-critical environments, with at least 3 years in a leadership or management capacity
Deep expertise in low-latency network design and optimization, with a strong understanding of switching behavior, buffering, and techniques required to achieve deterministic performance at scale
Advanced knowledge of Layer 2 and Layer 3 protocols, including BGP, OSPF, MPLS, VXLAN, multicast (PIM-SM), and resilient traffic engineering across global networks
Proven ability to design, scale, and operate complex, highly available network infrastructure in environments where performance and reliability are critical to the business
Strong track record of leading and developing engineering teams, including mentoring senior engineers, driving technical standards, and building a high-performance, accountable culture
Experience leading large, complex projects from research and design through implementation, with disciplined execution and strong operational rigor
Hands-on experience with network automation using Python and API-driven approaches to improve efficiency, consistency, and scalability
Solid understanding of network security principles, including segmentation, access control, and secure design practices within enterprise and trading network environments
Experience managing competing priorities in a fast-paced, dynamic environment, with the ability to align engineering work to business needs and drive execution under pressure
Strong communication and leadership presence, with the ability to clearly articulate technical strategy, risks, and trade-offs to both engineering teams and senior leadership
Experience working with distributed teams and partnering across infrastructure, security, and application organizations
Familiarity with contributing to architecture standards, technical documentation, and, where applicable, materials supporting regulatory or audit requirements

Preferred certifications:

Cisco CCIE (Routing & Switching or Data Center) or equivalent expert-level experience
Arista, Juniper, or other advanced networking certifications

At LinkedIn, our approach to flexible work is centered on trust and optimized for culture, connection, clarity, and the evolving needs of our business. The work location of this role is hybrid, meaning it will be performed both from home and from a LinkedIn office on select days, as determined by the business needs of the team.

The Enterprise Technology Experience (ETE) organization delivers the technology experience for every LinkedIn employee, from the moment they open their laptop to the moment a global all-hands goes live. The team owns Employee Technology Foundations, Media (Live/Video/Events), Enterprise Application Support and Reliability, and an Agentic Service Platform that is transforming how employees get help and how the enterprise detects and resolves issues before employees ever notice them.

We are seeking a seasoned operations and experience leader to own strategy, execution, and outcomes for LinkedIn's global employee technology experience. This leader will be responsible for the end-to-end experience portfolio: global employee support operations and managed service provider (MSP) ecosystems, on-site and virtual office experience models, employee-facing incident response, and the AI-driven service transformation that is shifting the organization from reactive ticketing to proactive, agent-assisted, monitor-detected resolution.

This is not a traditional IT support leadership role. The right candidate leads with experience-first thinking, where the employee's felt experience is the primary product, and treats operational metrics, automation, and reliability engineering as the means to that end.

Roles and Responsibilities

Define and drive a multi-year vision for the global employee technology experience, balancing experience quality, reliability, velocity, and cost efficiency across on-site, hybrid, and fully virtual office models.

Own global employee support operations end-to-end: service desk, tech bars/walk-up experiences, deskside services, executive support, and new-hire technology onboarding across all regions.

Lead a multi-vendor MSP ecosystem, vendor strategy, contract negotiation, consolidation, and performance management, aligning investments and SLAs/XLAs to measurable experience outcomes rather than ticket throughput alone.

Drive AI and agentic transformation of the service experience: champion self-healing, autonomous triage, and virtual agent support so an increasing share of employee issues are detected by monitoring and resolved by automation before an employee has to report them.

Establish and own experience-first measurement: shift the organization from employee-notified to monitor-detected incident discovery, and mature XLA/CSAT, time-to-restore, and deflection metrics that tie directly to how work feels for employees.

Partner with Site Reliability and Service Management functions on employee-facing incident response — clear communications, predictable escalation, and blameless post-incident learning for high-severity events affecting the workforce.

Scale the virtual office operating model: deliver a consistent, high-quality technology experience for global offices without on-site IT presence, including remote support tooling, smart lockers/vending, and localized logistics.

Oversee enterprise application support and reliability for the business-critical SaaS and internal application portfolio, ensuring clear ownership, escalation paths, and reliability standards.

Support world-class media, live event, and broadcast experiences in partnership with events and communications stakeholders — from executive all-hands to global broadcast moments.

Establish annual goals/OKRs and measurable outcomes tied to experience health, operational efficiency, and TCO (e.g., monitor-detected rate, XLA attainment, deflection/automation rate, cost per employee supported).

Scale org effectiveness across globally distributed teams and blended workforce models (FTE, contingent, MSP); ensure strong on-call, runbooks, knowledge management, and incident leadership practices.

Hire, coach, and grow a diverse leadership bench (Sr. Managers, Managers, Staff+ ICs); foster a culture of clarity, accountability, craftsmanship, and bias for action.

Responsible for defining/deciding employee-level hardware standards (laptops, monitors, peripherals, etc.) and forecasting global purchasing for this hardware.

Compliance & audit responsibilities - SOX controls, MSFT audits, etc.

Qualifications

Basic Qualifications

B.A./B.S. Degree or higher in Computer Science, Information Systems, or related technical discipline, or equivalent practical experience.

12+ years of experience in enterprise technology, IT operations, or employee experience engineering, with 8+ years of people management experience.

Experience leading global support operations, managed service provider ecosystems, or enterprise service delivery at scale.

Preferred Qualifications

Demonstrated outcomes transforming reactive IT support organizations into proactive, experience-first, automation-driven service organizations.

Hands-on leadership deploying AI/agentic capabilities in enterprise service contexts — virtual agents, autonomous triage, self-healing endpoints, and intelligent deflection.

Deep experience with experience-level agreements (XLAs), employee sentiment measurement, and telemetry-driven proactive detection (DEX platforms, endpoint analytics).

Track record of managing multi-vendor/MSP environments and large operating budgets tied to business outcomes, including global RFPs, consolidations, and renewals.

Experience operating blended and distributed workforce models, including significant workforce transitions, while sustaining service quality and team culture.

Familiarity with ITSM/ITIL practices and modern service management platforms, and with evolving them rather than being constrained by them.

Experience supporting live media, events, and executive broadcast environments is a plus.

Exceptional stakeholder management with executive communication and data-driven decision-making.

Ability to clearly communicate with all levels of the organization and across functions, and translate strategy to execution.

Strong analytical and communication skills with the ability to influence and work effectively across organizational boundaries.

Ability to maintain good judgment in fast-paced, high-stress environments, including major incident conditions.

Ability to innovate and scale ideas/processes to large teams.

Deep CRM System expertise (ServiceNow, Oracle Service Cloud / Fusion, Salesforce, etc.) - ability to understand, dive into, and suggest workflow changes that sit on the back-office side of the employee support experience.

Employee Experience & Service Delivery

Leadership

AI & Service Automation

Job Description

As a Director of Advanced Infrastructure Solutions (AI/HPC), you will act as a trusted advisor to customers and internal stakeholders, providing deep technical expertise across AI, HPC, accelerated computing, and advanced data center technologies. The role is responsible for leading technical discovery, supporting solution development, guiding architecture discussions, and helping customers align infrastructure investments with their business objectives. Partnering closely with sales, engineering, and delivery teams, you will develop scalable, high-performance infrastructure solutions and provide technical leadership throughout the customer engagement lifecycle, from initial requirements gathering through implementation planning and deployment readiness.

Responsibilities

Responsible for planning, budgeting, administration, and management of team capacity, operations, and strategic initiatives supporting advanced data center and AI/HPC infrastructure environments.
Provide technical leadership and guidance to internal and external customers, including participating in technical discovery and pre-sales support activities such as requirement validation, solution alignment, and design discussions.
Partner closely with sales and solution stakeholders to support customer pursuits by contributing technical expertise, validating proposed architectures, and helping position infrastructure solutions effectively.
Act as a technical advisor to customers, helping walk through infrastructure designs, deployment considerations, and implementation approaches for complex environments.
Contribute to the development and refinement of reference architectures, solution patterns, and best practices for AI, GPU-enabled systems, and data center infrastructure.
Support complex infrastructure design discussions across domains such as compute, GPU platforms, networking, storage, and facility considerations.
Oversee vendor training activities and technical enablement for team members and the broader TSS organization, including emerging technologies and platforms.
Develop and approve processes, procedures, and policies to drive continual improvements in technical support delivery and customer experience.
Maintain reporting of KPIs and provide insights to senior management, incorporating learnings from advanced infrastructure engagements.
Develop, review, and approve technical documentation including best practices, architecture guidance, troubleshooting methodologies, and customer-facing materials.
Coach and mentor a team of experienced technical professionals and managers, strengthening capabilities in advanced infrastructure, customer engagement, and solution support.
Communicate with engineering, applications engineering, marketing, category management, supply chain, and quality teams regarding product gaps, emerging technologies, and customer needs.
Deliver presentations to senior management, customers, and industry audiences, including technical workshops and pre-sales engagements.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree required; Engineering, Information Technology, or related field preferred.
13+ years of experience in high performance computin infrastructure, data center technologies, or related technical domains including design, implementation, or support.
2+ years of experience leading a team of at least 6 direct reports preferred.
Experience supporting or contributing to customer-facing technical solutioning or pre-sales activities.
Strong knowledge or experience with data center infrastructure, server platforms, and advanced compute technologies, including exposure to GPU-based systems or AI workloads.
Expertise with leading technology vendors such as NVIDIA, Dell Lenovo, Supermicro, Broadcom, Qualcomm, and Intel, and understanding of their role in modern infrastructure ecosystems.
Exposure to AI inference, accelerated compute, or HPC environments, including relevant certifications or equivalent experience, is required.
Understanding of infrastructure design considerations including compute, networking, storage, and facility constraints.
NVIDIA AI certifcation preferred
CCIE certification or equivalent preferred
Strong leadership, coaching, and cross-functional collaboration skills.
Strong presentation skills with experience engaging technical and senior-level audiences.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office tools.
Ability to travel up to 25%.

jobs.title: Director/Managing Director, AI Software Development
jobs.description:
Job Description

As CohnReznick grows, so do our career opportunities. As one of the nation’s top professional services firms, CohnReznick creates rewarding careers in advisory, assurance, and tax with team members who value innovation and collaboration in everything they do!

CohnReznick helps organizations optimize performance, manage risk, and maximize value through CohnReznick LLP (assurance services) and CohnReznick Advisory LLC (advisory and tax services). Together, the firm provides leaders with deep industry knowledge and relationships, solutions to address clients’ unique business goals and risks, and insight on how emerging market forces can drive opportunity. With offices nationwide, the firm serves organizations around the world as an independent member of Nexia.

We currently have an exciting career opportunity for a Director/Managing Director, AI Software Development
to support our Global Digital & CyberSecurity
practice.

CohnReznick is a hybrid firm and most of our professionals are located within a commutable distance to one of our offices. This position is considered remote which means it does not require job duties be performed within proximity of a CohnReznick office location. However, as a remote employee, you may be required to be present at a CohnReznick office with scheduled notice for client work, team meetings, or trainings.

YOUR TEAM.

The Director / Managing Director, AI Software Development is a senior technology leader responsible for establishing and leading CohnReznick's software engineering capability. This position defines the vision, strategy, operating model, talent plan, architecture, and delivery approach for AI-enabled products, platforms, and solutions across the firm.

The position is accountable for building a high-performing AI-native software development organization capable of delivering proprietary technology assets that create sustainable competitive advantage. The leader oversees the design, development, deployment, and operation of AI-powered applications, intelligent automation solutions, agentic workflows, and client-facing digital products.

This is not a traditional application-development leadership role. The successful candidate must have personally built and scaled a native AI software team from inception through production delivery, including recruiting specialized talent, establishing engineering and governance standards, and delivering secure applications with measurable business impact.

WHY COHNREZNICK?

At CohnReznick, we’re united by a common mission to create opportunity, value, and trust for our clients, our people, and our communities. Whether it’s working alongside your peers to solve a client challenge, or volunteering together at the local food bank, there are so many ways to find your “why” at the firm.

We believe it’s important to balance work with everyday life – and make time for enjoyment and fun. We invest in a robust Total Rewards package that includes everything from generous PTO, a flexible work environment, expanded parental leave, extensive learning & development, and even paid time off for employees to volunteer.

YOUR ROLE.

Responsibilities Include But Not Limited To

AI strategy and portfolio leadership

Define and execute a multi-year AI software engineering strategy aligned with firm business and technology objectives.
Establish the vision, roadmap, investment priorities, and operating model for the GDC AI development capability.
Identify opportunities to create proprietary software assets that improve client service, quality, efficiency, growth, and professional experience.
Advise executive leaders and governance forums on opportunities, investments, risks, dependencies, and portfolio performance.

Native AI organization building

Recruit, organize, develop, and retain a multidisciplinary team of AI engineers, software engineers, machine learning engineers, technical leads, and architects.
Define job architecture, role expectations, career paths, leadership spans, technical communities, and talent-development practices for the AI engineering function.
Create an engineering culture centered on innovation, responsible experimentation, accountability, inclusion, collaboration, and disciplined production delivery.
Build a sustainable talent pipeline and develop future engineering leaders.

Product and solution delivery

Lead AI-enabled products, platforms, and solutions from discovery and architecture through engineering, release, adoption, operation, and continuous improvement.
Partner with Product Management and business stakeholders to translate strategic priorities into sequenced, funded, and measurable delivery commitments.
Manage execution across concurrent initiatives while balancing value, speed, quality, security, risk, reliability, and maintainability.
Establish outcome, delivery, quality, adoption, and operational measures; use results to improve priorities and execution.

Architecture, engineering, and operations

Establish development standards, reference architectures, engineering frameworks, reusable components, testing practices, and technical quality controls.
Define patterns for large language model integration, agentic systems, retrieval-augmented generation, intelligent workflow automation, observability, evaluation, and model operations.
Implement modern cloud-native engineering, DevSecOps, CI/CD, API, integration, reliability, incident-management, and lifecycle-management practices.
Promote reuse, platform leverage, technical-debt management, and reduction of unnecessary technology redundancy.

Governance, risk, and stakeholder leadership

Embed security, privacy, legal, regulatory, records-management, data-governance, and responsible AI requirements throughout the development lifecycle.
Partner with Enterprise Architecture, Information Security, Data & Analytics, Risk, Legal, and other control functions to govern design and deployment decisions.
Communicate complex technical matters in clear business terms and build trusted relationships with executives, professionals, clients, vendors, and strategic partners.
Drive adoption, change leadership, knowledge transfer, and transparent reporting of progress, risks, decisions, and realized value.

The duties listed are intended to describe the general nature and level of work performed. They are not an exhaustive list of every responsibility, duty, or skill required. Responsibilities may change based on business needs.

Your Experience.

The successful candidate will have:

Education And Experience

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.
Fifteen or more years of progressive software engineering and technology leadership experience.
Seven or more years leading software development organizations, including leaders of engineering teams.
Five or more years delivering AI-enabled applications, machine learning platforms, intelligent automation solutions, or generative AI products.
Demonstrated success creating and scaling a native AI software development organization that moved beyond pilots and experimentation to secure, production-grade solutions.
Proven delivery of enterprise-grade software products and platforms in complex, regulated, or high-trust environments.
Experience leading geographically distributed teams and a blended workforce of employees, contractors, and strategic partners.

Technical and delivery expertise

Generative AI, large language models, agentic architectures, retrieval-augmented generation, AI evaluation, observability, and model operations.
Cloud-native software development, enterprise application architecture, APIs, integration patterns, data platforms, and analytics ecosystems.
DevSecOps, CI/CD, automated testing, software supply-chain controls, production reliability, and secure development lifecycle practices.
Responsible AI, AI governance, privacy, security, model risk, data governance, and human oversight.
Product-oriented delivery using measurable outcomes, iterative development, user feedback, adoption measures, and value realization.

Preferred Qualifications

Advanced degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Business, or a related field.
Leadership experience in professional services, financial services, regulated industries, or enterprise B2B software.
Experience with Microsoft Azure AI, Azure OpenAI, Microsoft Copilot technologies, and modern AI engineering frameworks.
Relevant credentials in AI, cloud architecture, software engineering, cybersecurity, or product delivery.
Experience commercializing proprietary software or creating client-facing digital products and technology-enabled services.

In addition, please take a moment to review our Universal Job Standards.

Studies have shown that we are less likely to apply to jobs unless we meet every single qualification. At CohnReznick, we are dedicated to building a diverse, equitable, and inclusive workplace, so if you’re excited about this role but your experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we still encourage you to apply. You may be just the right candidate for this or one of our other roles.

Salary is one component of the CohnReznick total rewards package, which includes a discretionary performance bonus, generous paid time off, expanded and inclusive parental benefits, and access to best-in-class learning and development platforms, to name a few. The leader oversees the design, development, deployment, and operation of AI-powered applications, intelligent automation solutions, agentic workflows, and client-facing digital products.

This is not a traditional application-development leadership role. The successful candidate must have personally built and scaled a native AI software team from inception through production delivery, including recruiting specialized talent, establishing engineering and governance standards, and delivering secure applications with measurable business impact.

WHY COHNREZNICK?

We invest in a robust Total Rewards package that includes everything from generous PTO, a flexible work environment, expanded parental leave, extensive learning & development, and even paid time off for employees to volunteer.

YOUR ROLE.

AI strategy and portfolio leadership

Define and execute a multi-year AI software engineering strategy aligned with firm business and technology objectives.
Establish the vision, roadmap, investment priorities, and operating model for the GDC AI development capability.
Identify opportunities to create proprietary software assets that improve client service, quality, efficiency, growth, and professional experience.
Advise executive leaders and governance forums on opportunities, investments, risks, dependencies, and portfolio performance.

Native AI organization building

Recruit, organize, develop, and retain a multidisciplinary team of AI engineers, software engineers, machine learning engineers, technical leads, and architects.
Define job architecture, role expectations, career paths, leadership spans, technical communities, and talent-development practices for the AI engineering function.
Create an engineering culture centered on innovation, responsible experimentation, accountability, inclusion, collaboration, and disciplined production delivery.
Build a sustainable talent pipeline and develop future engineering leaders.

Product and solution delivery

Lead AI-enabled products, platforms, and solutions from discovery and architecture through engineering, release, adoption, operation, and continuous improvement.
Partner with Product Management and business stakeholders to translate strategic priorities into sequenced, funded, and measurable delivery commitments.
Manage execution across concurrent initiatives while balancing value, speed, quality, security, risk, reliability, and maintainability.
Establish outcome, delivery, quality, adoption, and operational measures; use results to improve priorities and execution.

Architecture, engineering, and operations

Establish development standards, reference architectures, engineering frameworks, reusable components, testing practices, and technical quality controls.
Define patterns for large language model integration, agentic systems, retrieval-augmented generation, intelligent workflow automation, observability, evaluation, and model operations.
Implement modern cloud-native engineering, DevSecOps, CI/CD, API, integration, reliability, incident-management, and lifecycle-management practices.
Promote reuse, platform leverage, technical-debt management, and reduction of unnecessary technology redundancy.

Governance, risk, and stakeholder leadership

Embed security, privacy, legal, regulatory, records-management, data-governance, and responsible AI requirements throughout the development lifecycle.
Partner with Enterprise Architecture, Information Security, Data & Analytics, Risk, Legal, and other control functions to govern design and deployment decisions.
Communicate complex technical matters in clear business terms and build trusted relationships with executives, professionals, clients, vendors, and strategic partners.
Drive adoption, change leadership, knowledge transfer, and transparent reporting of progress, risks, decisions, and realized value.

The duties listed are intended to describe the general nature and level of work performed. They are not an exhaustive list of every responsibility, duty, or skill required. Responsibilities may change based on business needs.

Your Experience.

The successful candidate will have:

Education And Experience

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.
Fifteen or more years of progressive software engineering and technology leadership experience.
Seven or more years leading software development organizations, including leaders of engineering teams.
Five or more years delivering AI-enabled applications, machine learning platforms, intelligent automation solutions, or generative AI products.
Demonstrated success creating and scaling a native AI software development organization that moved beyond pilots and experimentation to secure, production-grade solutions.
Proven delivery of enterprise-grade software products and platforms in complex, regulated, or high-trust environments.
Experience leading geographically distributed teams and a blended workforce of employees, contractors, and strategic partners.

Technical and delivery expertise

Generative AI, large language models, agentic architectures, retrieval-augmented generation, AI evaluation, observability, and model operations.
Cloud-native software development, enterprise application architecture, APIs, integration patterns, data platforms, and analytics ecosystems.
DevSecOps, CI/CD, automated testing, software supply-chain controls, production reliability, and secure development lifecycle practices.
Responsible AI, AI governance, privacy, security, model risk, data governance, and human oversight.
Product-oriented delivery using measurable outcomes, iterative development, user feedback, adoption measures, and value realization.

jobs.title: Director, Technology Infrastructure Architecture
jobs.description:
Want to help pets live their best lives?

We’re proud to be where the pets go and where the pet people go. If you want to make a real difference, create an exciting career path, feel welcome to be your whole self and nurture your wellbeing, Petco is the place for you
.

Our core values capture that spirit as we work to improve lives by doing what’s right for pets and people.

Pet First – Protect & Empower. All pets should Live their Best Life. We put the needs of pets and pet parents at the center of everything we do.
Foster the Fun – Connect & Bond. Our Passion for pets brings us together! We celebrate the journey of pet parenthood through district experiences, products, and services.
Let’s Go! Own & Commit. We are stronger as One Petco team. We bring our unique superpowers and champion authenticity in everyone to drive success.

About Petco

We’re proud to be "where the pets go"
to find everything they need to live their best lives for more than 60 years — from their favorite meals and toys, to trusted supplies and expert support from people who get it, because we live it. We believe in the universal truths of pet parenthood — the boundless boops, missing slippers, late night zoomies and everything in between. And we’re here for it. Every tail wag, every vet visit, every step of the way. We are 29,000+
strong and together we nurture the pet-human bond in more than 1,500
Petco stores across the U.S., Mexico and Puerto Rico, 250+
Vetco Total Care hospitals, hundreds of preventive care clinics and eight distribution centers. In 1999, we founded Petco Love. Together, we support thousands of local animal welfare groups nationwide and have helped find homes for approximately 7 million animals
through in-store adoption events.

Director, Technology Infrastructure Architecture

Duties & Responsibilities

Builds and leads the Technology Infrastructure Architecture (TIA) function as a new, dedicated team, ensuring security is integrated seamlessly into enterprise infrastructure projects from the design phase, accelerating safe technology delivery
Responsible for long-range secure infrastructure architecture strategy and planning across cloud, on-premise, and endpoint environments supporting both retail and enterprise operations
Acts as the face of the TIA team to the business and the primary liaison between TIA, senior IT leadership, Operations teams, Information Security, and Engineering leaders; ensures TIA is engaged early in business projects
Manages the cross functional team for architecture reviews and new business projects; defines and tracks team KPIs (e.g., shift-left engagement, design flaw reduction)
Embeds cybersecurity principles into all architecture decisions; drives secure-by-design principles, zero trust adoption, threat modeling, and network segmentation standards in partnership with Information Security
Enforces established security reference architectures and standards — identity and access, network segmentation, ZTNA/SASE, encryption, and cloud security posture — throughout project designs and reviews
Operates as a hands-on player-coach — prototypes, builds reference architectures, and works alongside engineers to unblock delivery, bringing velocity to new projects rather than governance overhead
Leads implementation and enterprise change management for infrastructure and security initiatives — plans, sequences, and drives changes through build, testing, and rollout, ensuring architectural decisions are executed and adopted across store and enterprise environments rather than handed off
Partners closely with the existing Network Operations organization to ensure new designs are operable, observable, and transition cleanly into steady-state support
Owns budget planning and management for the TIA team, including capital and operating forecasts for new projects, and provides architectural input to cloud cost governance (FinOps) and infrastructure investment decisions
Champions and personally contributes to automation and infrastructure-as-code practices and the adoption of AI-driven operations (AIOps) to shift the organization from reactive to predictive operations
Evaluates and pilots emerging networking technologies (e.g., SASE, micro segmentation, cloud-native IaC, AI-assisted operational automation) hands-on before recommending broad adoption
Identifies interdependencies and emerging trends across interrelated technology efforts and programs to continuously improve infrastructure services
Recruits, develops, and mentors architects and senior engineers for the new team; builds a culture of ownership, delivery velocity, and accountability
Manages strategic vendor and technology partner relationships supporting architecture initiatives and new-project delivery

Minimum Qualifications

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering or other related fields, or equivalent work experience
10+ years in Network Engineering, Enterprise Security, or Systems Architecture, with at least 3+ years in a leadership/management role influencing senior level management and key stakeholders
Highly technical and hands-on, with strong executive communication skills — able to represent the team credibly to senior leadership and engineering teams alike
Requires advanced technical and business knowledge in infrastructure and security architecture, enterprise network engineering (LAN/WAN/WLAN, SD-WAN, carrier services), and IT financial/budget management
Demonstrated cybersecurity experience: strong background in enterprise risk management and security framework adoption (NIST, CIS, PCI DSS, zero trust), applying security controls to architecture decisions and leading teams to deliver secure infrastructure
Relevant certifications a plus: CISSP, CISM, or SABSA (security); CCNP/CCIE (network); ITIL; major cloud certifications

AI strategy and portfolio leadership

Define and execute a multi-year AI software engineering strategy aligned with firm business and technology objectives.
Establish the vision, roadmap, investment priorities, and operating model for the GDC AI development capability.
Identify opportunities to create proprietary software assets that improve client service, quality, efficiency, growth, and professional experience.
Advise executive leaders and governance forums on opportunities, investments, risks, dependencies, and portfolio performance.

Native AI organization building

Recruit, organize, develop, and retain a multidisciplinary team of AI engineers, software engineers, machine learning engineers, technical leads, and architects.
Define job architecture, role expectations, career paths, leadership spans, technical communities, and talent-development practices for the AI engineering function.
Create an engineering culture centered on innovation, responsible experimentation, accountability, inclusion, collaboration, and disciplined production delivery.
Build a sustainable talent pipeline and develop future engineering leaders.

Product and solution delivery

Lead AI-enabled products, platforms, and solutions from discovery and architecture through engineering, release, adoption, operation, and continuous improvement.
Partner with Product Management and business stakeholders to translate strategic priorities into sequenced, funded, and measurable delivery commitments.
Manage execution across concurrent initiatives while balancing value, speed, quality, security, risk, reliability, and maintainability.
Establish outcome, delivery, quality, adoption, and operational measures; use results to improve priorities and execution.

Architecture, engineering, and operations

Establish development standards, reference architectures, engineering frameworks, reusable components, testing practices, and technical quality controls.
Define patterns for large language model integration, agentic systems, retrieval-augmented generation, intelligent workflow automation, observability, evaluation, and model operations.
Implement modern cloud-native engineering, DevSecOps, CI/CD, API, integration, reliability, incident-management, and lifecycle-management practices.
Promote reuse, platform leverage, technical-debt management, and reduction of unnecessary technology redundancy.

Governance, risk, and stakeholder leadership

Embed security, privacy, legal, regulatory, records-management, data-governance, and responsible AI requirements throughout the development lifecycle.
Partner with Enterprise Architecture, Information Security, Data & Analytics, Risk, Legal, and other control functions to govern design and deployment decisions.
Communicate complex technical matters in clear business terms and build trusted relationships with executives, professionals, clients, vendors, and strategic partners.
Drive adoption, change leadership, knowledge transfer, and transparent reporting of progress, risks, decisions, and realized value.

The duties listed are intended to describe the general nature and level of work performed. They are not an exhaustive list of every responsibility, duty, or skill required. Responsibilities may change based on business needs.

Your Experience.

The successful candidate will have:

Education And Experience

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.
Fifteen or more years of progressive software engineering and technology leadership experience.
Seven or more years leading software development organizations, including leaders of engineering teams.
Five or more years delivering AI-enabled applications, machine learning platforms, intelligent automation solutions, or generative AI products.
Demonstrated success creating and scaling a native AI software development organization that moved beyond pilots and experimentation to secure, production-grade solutions.
Proven delivery of enterprise-grade software products and platforms in complex, regulated, or high-trust environments.
Experience leading geographically distributed teams and a blended workforce of employees, contractors, and strategic partners.

Technical and delivery expertise

Generative AI, large language models, agentic architectures, retrieval-augmented generation, AI evaluation, observability, and model operations.
Cloud-native software development, enterprise application architecture, APIs, integration patterns, data platforms, and analytics ecosystems.
DevSecOps, CI/CD, automated testing, software supply-chain controls, production reliability, and secure development lifecycle practices.
Responsible AI, AI governance, privacy, security, model risk, data governance, and human oversight.
Product-oriented delivery using measurable outcomes, iterative development, user feedback, adoption measures, and value realization.

Preferred Qualifications

Advanced degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Business, or a related field.
Leadership experience in professional services, financial services, regulated industries, or enterprise B2B software.
Experience with Microsoft Azure AI, Azure OpenAI, Microsoft Copilot technologies, and modern AI engineering frameworks.

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Foundry Silicon Technology Enablement
jobs.description:
Please Note

To provide the best candidate experience amidst our high application volumes, each candidate is limited to 10 applications across all open jobs within a 6-month period.

Advancing the World’s Technology Together

Our technology solutions power the tools you use every day--including smartphones, electric vehicles, hyperscale data centers, IoT devices, and so much more. Here, you’ll have an opportunity to be part of a global leader whose innovative designs are pushing the boundaries of what’s possible and powering the future.

We believe innovation and growth are driven by an inclusive culture and a diverse workforce. We’re dedicated to empowering people to be their true selves. Together, we’re building a better tomorrow for our employees, customers, partners, and communities.

What You’ll Do

In this role as Senior Staff Engineer (Senior Manager), Foundry Silicon Technical Enablement, you will spearhead technical engagements with customers and ASIC partners to define critical product and platform technology requirements, identify and quantify technology gaps, and drive solutions to address these gaps. Collaborating closely with cross-functional teams, including IP, Packaging, Customer Engineering, Design Enablement, ASIC design, and account management, you will foster early technical engagement to enable customized silicon solutions across various technology nodes, ensuring successful delivery of customer-focused outcomes.

You will also drive benchmarking activities to understand the Competitive landscape, set/refine PPA scaling targets, drive necessary recommendations and influence roadmaps to ensure Samsung Foundry continues to stay in leadership position.

Additionally, you will support Business Development activities for new customers in conjunction with account management teams with the goal of securing new business and also exploring differentiated Technology solutions through strategic collaboration.

Location: Daily onsite presence in San Jose HQ location in alignment with our Flexible Work policy with an average of 10% travel per month

Reports to: VP, Technical Marketing

Req: 42975

Develop and build deep trust-based relationships with customers’ teams to understand their Si technology needs, application requirements and jointly define the best technology/platform solutions to enable customer’s products

Work with customer teams to map their requirements to existing foundry offerings, identify potential gaps, and champion their cause by driving internal development teams to address technology needs and deliver technology solutions
Work with the internal Silicon development teams to align on upcoming technology/ scaling trends and set competitive technology targets and differentiated roadmaps
Enable platform solutions (Process, IP, advanced packaging, ASIC etc) with Technology, Ecosystem, Enablement, Design Services and Business development teams. This includes any new potential partnerships with both Internal and External teams
Attend conferences with the goal of publishing regular analysis and benchmarking reports.
Support the Technology engagement and Business growth activities by working with cross-functional teams across Engineering, Sales and Business Development teams to secure customer engagements.
Complete other responsibilities as assigned.

What You Bring

Bachelor’s in Electrical Engineering or related Physical Science with 15+ years of experience or Master’s in Electrical Engineering or related Physical Science with 13+ Years of Industry Experience or PhD in Electrical Engineer or related Physical Science with 10+ years of Industry Experience.
Knowledge of CMOS fundamentals, Device Physics, Advanced Process technology, circuit design concepts, device-technology interactions, scaling trends and their forthcoming challenges.
Experience in Logic Technology development and working with Foundries is a plus.
Broad understanding of systems and application requirements (eg product architecture, key IPs, packaging, design services, ASIC, key standards etc)
Experience with PPA analysis across libraries, memory compilers, Block-level PPA and competitive benchmarking
Experience in Automotive segments requirements including reliability and functional safety. Experience on RF technologies and key figures of merit is a plus.
You’re inclusive, adapting your style to the situation and diverse global norms of our people.
An avid learner, you approach challenges with curiosity and resilience, seeking data to help build understanding.
You’re collaborative, building relationships, humbly offering support and openly welcoming approaches.
Innovative and creative, you proactively explore new ideas and adapt quickly to change.

What We Offer

The pay range below is for all roles at this level across all US locations and functions. Pay within this range varies by work location and may also depend on job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. We also offer incentive opportunities that reward employees based on individual and company performance.

This is in addition to our diverse package of benefits centered around the wellbeing of our employees and their loved ones. In addition to the usual Medical/Dental/Vision/401k, our inclusive rewards plan empowers our people to care for their whole selves. An investment in your future is an investment in ours.

Give Back
With a charitable giving match and frequent opportunities to get involved, we take an active role in supporting the community.

Enjoy Time Away
You’ll start with 4+ weeks of paid time off a year, plus holidays and sick leave, to rest and recharge.

Care for Family
Whatever family means to you, we want to support you along the way—including a stipend for fertility care or adoption, medical travel support, and virtual vet care for your fur babies.

Prioritize Emotional Wellness
With on-demand apps and free confidential therapy sessions, you’ll have support no matter where you are.

Stay Fit
Eating well and being active are important parts of a healthy life. Our onsite Café and gym, plus virtual classes, make it easier.

Embrace Flexibility
Benefits are best when you have the space to use them. That’s why we facilitate a flexible environment so you can find the right balance for you.

Base Pay Range

$189,000—$301,000 USD

Equal Opportunity Employment Policy

Samsung Semiconductor takes pride in being an equal opportunity workplace dedicated to fostering an environment where all individuals feel valued and empowered to excel, regardless of race, religion, color, age, disability, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, ancestry, genetic information, marital status, national origin, political affiliation, or veteran status.

When selecting team members, we prioritize talent and qualities such as humility, kindness, and dedication. We extend comprehensive accommodations throughout our recruiting processes for candidates with disabilities, long-term conditions, neurodivergent individuals, or those requiring pregnancy-related support. All candidates scheduled for an interview will receive guidance on requesting accommodations.

Our Commitment to Innovation and Fairness

At Samsung Semiconductor, we use Artificial Intelligence (AI) tools in the recruitment process to enhance efficiency. However, AI is used as a support tool, not a final decision-maker. All hiring decisions are made by our human recruiting team and hiring managers to ensure every candidate is evaluated fairly and holistically.

Recruiting Agency Policy

We do not accept unsolicited resumes. Only authorized recruitment agencies that have a current and valid agreement with Samsung Semiconductor, Inc. are permitted to submit resumes for any job openings.

Applicant AI Use Policy

At Samsung Semiconductor, we support innovation and technology. However, to ensure a fair and authentic assessment, we ask that candidates rely on their own knowledge and skills throughout the process. AI tools may be used for basic preparation, grammar, and research, but should not be used to generate or assist with submitted content or live interview responses. If we determine that AI is being used outside these guidelines, we reserve the right to pause or end the interview, and your candidacy may be disqualified.

Trade Secret Notice

By submitting an application, you agree not to disclose to Samsung—or encourage Samsung to use—any confidential or proprietary information (including trade secrets) belonging to a current or former employer or other entity.

jobs.description:
Are you ready to make an impact at DTCC?

Do you want to work on innovative projects, collaborate with a dynamic and supportive team, and receive investment in your professional development? At DTCC, we are at the forefront of innovation in the financial markets. We're committed to helping our employees grow and succeed. We believe that you have the skills and drive to make a real impact. We foster a thriving internal community and are committed to creating a workplace that looks like the world that we serve.

Pay And Benefits

Competitive compensation, including base pay and annual incentive
Comprehensive health and life insurance and well-being benefits, based on location
Pension / Retirement benefits
Paid Time Off and Personal/Family Care, and other leaves of absence when needed to support your physical, financial, and emotional well-being.
DTCC offers a flexible/hybrid model of 3 days onsite and 2 days remote (onsite Tuesdays, Wednesdays and a third day unique to each team or employee).

The Impact You Will Have In This Role

The Director of Cloud Data Engineering is responsible for leading the strategic direction and execution of cloud data platforms. This role collaborates with the Executive Director of the Cloud Center for Enablement (CC4E) and involves leading all aspects of the engineers delivering cloud data technologies and business intelligence consisting of Snowflake, Power BI, Sigma, Looker, AWS QuickSight. The Director will work closely with multi-functional teams to deliver innovative cloud data solutions that meet critical technology, security, and business requirements.

Your Primary Responsibilities

Provide experienced leadership in developing and implementing cloud data strategies.
Coordinate the implementation of cloud data platform, ensuring scalability and security while aligned with business goals.
Facilitate meetings with business partners and technology teams to build consensus and make solution decisions without compromising delivery and/or service.
Assist enterprise architecture, service management, security, and risk teams in creating technical standards, identifying and mitigating risks, and driving solutions for the enterprise.
Create, modify, and adapt solutions to keep the organization aligned between business requirements and technology capabilities.
Provide foresight into potential future technology trends or issues that will affect the organization and develop mitigation plans to address them.
Work as a liaison to teams providing standards and platforms for future application development and help develop team members to apply the technologies.
Align existing application portfolios to cloud data standards and services.
Be a highly motivated and active technology leader within multiple work streams and manage deliveries across multiple projects.
Review and evaluate new technologies that could be beneficial to the enterprise.
Analyze problems, define solutions, and articulate them clearly to all levels of the organization, from senior leadership to professional staff.
Stay abreast of business, operational, and technology trends that may affect the portfolio and strategy.
Align the products and services offered by Cloud Data Engineering with the needs of its enterprise customers and leadership
Provide ongoing on-boarding, training, and organizational change to ensure the organization successfully navigates and embraces the move to cloud data
Ensure that the senior leadership team is aligned and committed to moving to the cloud data, setting clear direction and expectations
Develop and implement a cloud data operating model that aligns business and IT capabilities, processes, and workforce to achieve strategic business outcomes

**NOTE: The Primary Responsibilities of this role are not limited to the details above. **

Qualifications

Minimum of 10 years of related experience
Bachelor's degree preferred and/or equivalent experience

Talents Needed For Success

10+ years of experience in technology management and implementation of highly scalable, highly available solutions, and services.
5+ years of experience with Public Cloud Data and Business Intelligence Technologies improving IaaS, PaaS, SaaS
Certified in Cloud Technologies (Snowflake, AWS, Azure, GCP), TOGAF, and ITIL certifications.
Demonstrated experience in working with cloud-based technologies (Amazon Web Services, Azure, GCP, Snowflake, Power BI) in an enterprise computing environment.
Experience creating a platform as a product to be consumed by application and technology teams.
Understanding of Software Development Lifecycle Methodologies and delivery processes (Agile, Scrum, Kanban).
Knowledge of ITSM practices (Incident, Problem Management, CMDB, Organizational Change).
Strong organizational, task, and project management skills.
Dedicated and able to work across diverse technical and non-technical teams.
Proven DevOps expertise, including automation and continuous delivery models.
Demonstrable record of solution design and implementation of scalable, reliable, secure, and high-performance organizations.

The salary range is indicative for roles at the same level within DTCC across all US locations. Actual salary is determined based on the role, location, individual experience, skills, and other considerations. We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. jobs.title: Director of Engineering
jobs.description:
At Early Warning, we’ve powered and protected the U.S. financial system for over thirty years with cutting-edge solutions like Zelle®, Paze℠, and so much more. As a trusted name in payments, we partner with thousands of institutions to increase access to financial services and protect transactions for hundreds of millions of consumers and small businesses.

Positions located in Scottsdale, San Francisco, Chicago, or New York follow a hybrid work model to allow for a more collaborative working environment.

Candidates responding to this posting must independently possess the eligibility to work in the United States, for any employer, at the date of hire. This position is ineligible for employment Visa sponsorship.

Overall Purpose

This position provides oversight to an assigned group within software engineering department and provides technical and organizational leadership. This position is responsible for directing and overseeing the work of architects and software engineers within the full software development lifecycle and all levels of testing. This position is also responsible for coordination of application architecture and design of new applications and enhancements to existing applications. Enhancing and collaborating in team environment by demonstrating an expertise in software engineering best practices and leading the team in continuous improvement initiatives.

Essential Functions

Direct and manage the functions of the staff to ensure delivery of quality software applications.
Responsible for the strategic direction and its alignment with IT and Early Warning’s strategic goals.
Evaluate existing methodologies/standards, identify and track metrics and recommend process improvements.
Direct and allocate resources and time for all projects and supported functions.
Represent technology organization by collaborating internally and externally.
Represent Software Delivery as a member of cross-functional project teams, estimating test efforts and providing updates on deliverables.
Review project status reports and quality metrics and address issues as appropriate.
Oversee and provide input on test plan creation and execution and creation of test summary.
Direct the ongoing research, evaluation, installation, and usage of automated testing tools for all developed applications.
Provide leadership in directing team to implement automated regression test suites on all production applications.
Build, develop and direct a highly performing team.
Actively contribute toward the vision, organization and strategic leadership of the Software Engineering department
Provide resource management to the team by participating in the hiring process, coordinating project assignments, documenting and executing annual performance evaluations
Provide leadership and guidance to staff for professional development, which includes planning and coordinating training, defining mentoring strategies, and providing hands on training and education
Ensure implementation of product / application services in alignment with technology roadmap strategy (example, cloud, containerization, CI/CD and automated testing) keeping futuristic business growth, ease of maintenance, operational readiness and self-service enabled.
Enhance and mature the Agile software development lifecycle within Software Engineering department by applying industry best practices & processes
Ensure the continuous improvement of the Agile SDLC by applying checks & balances around the process boundaries with regular reviews for the usefulness of steps & artifacts
Ensure accurate/reliable information to be within company standards including all service level agreements, and audit regulations
Research, collect, and present application / system improvements from vendors, seminars, and publications for existing or non-existent processes
Establish and maintain positive working relationships across the organization and perform as a representative of the IT Dept. in a consultant role to other functional areas within the organization
Guide other departments in understanding the technical solutions as necessary and helping them with defining ROI for related to proposed solutions
Keeps executive-level management informed of department progress and problems
Support the company’s commitment to risk management and protecting the integrity and confidentiality of systems and data

Minimum Qualifications

Master’s or Bachelor’s in Computer Information Systems/Computer Science
Ten (10) or more years of software engineering experience including at least 5 years of leadership experience
1-2 years of experience implementing application solutions/ services in Cloud using Containerization, CI/CD, Automated testing and in compliance security guidelines
Proven management and leadership skills in leading software engineering teams and their interaction across an organization. A big idea person who can also help with tactical day to day details
Demonstrated abilities in leading teams that build highly scalable products.
Demonstrated ability leading, mentoring and energizing teams of engineers and managers, showcasing technical and leadership skills
Demonstrated experience in the development of large, Internet applications with high operational and scalability requirements
Demonstrated experience with state- of- the- art technology, architecture and design concepts, open source operating systems, database systems, computer networking, and security
Experience with open source frameworks and tools
Proven experience in Agile software development philosophy, methodologies, practices, and procedures
5+ years of demonstrated ability to provide oversight for multiple projects simultaneously
Demonstrate ability to work effectively in cross-functional groups and generate results
Excellent interpersonal, oral, and written communication skills. Must convey responsiveness and competence when dealing with internal customers, staff, peers, senior management, and vendors
Work experience that demonstrates a strong sense of ownership, urgency, and drive
Experience with Big Data Java technologies
Ability to envision strategic goals, architectural solutions, and focus on details
Ability to work independently and handle multiple deadline-driven projects simultaneously
Background and drug screen

Preferred Qualifications

Payments experience
Experience with migrating application services from on-prem to Cloud.
Cloud / Kubernetes certification

The above job description is not intended to be an all-inclusive list of duties and standards of the position. Incumbents will follow instructions and perform other related duties as assigned by their supervisor.

Physical Requirements

Working conditions consist of a normal office environment. Work is primarily sedentary and requires extensive use of a computer and involves sitting for periods of approximately four hours. Work may require occasional standing, walking, kneeling and reaching. Must be able to lift 10 pounds occasionally and/or negligible amount of force frequently. Requires visual acuity and dexterity to view, prepare, and manipulate documents and office equipment including personal computers. Requires the ability to communicate with internal and/or external customers.

Employee must be able to perform essential functions and physical requirements of position with or without reasonable accommodation.

The Base Pay Scale For This Position In

Phoenix, AZ/ Chicago, IL in USD per year is: $173,000 - $230,000.

New York, NY/ San Francisco, CA in USD per year is: $207,000 - $276,000.

Additionally, candidates are eligible for a discretionary incentive plan and benefits.

This pay scale is subject to change and is not necessarily reflective of actual compensation that may be earned, nor a promise of any specific pay for any specific candidate, which is always dependent on legitimate factors considered at the time of job offer. Early Warning Services takes into consideration a variety of factors when determining a competitive salary offer, including, but not limited to, the job scope, market rates and geographic location of a position, candidate’s education, experience, training, and specialized skills or certification(s) in relation to the job requirements and compared with internal equity (peers). The business actively supports and reviews wage equity to ensure that pay decisions are not based on gender, race, national origin, or any other protected classes.

Some of the Ways We Prioritize Your Health and Happiness

Healthcare Coverage – Competitive medical (PPO/HDHP), dental, and vision plans as well as company contributions to your Health Savings Account (HSA) or pre-tax savings through flexible spending accounts (FSA) for commuting, health & dependent care expenses.
401(k) Retirement Plan – Featuring a 100% Company Safe Harbor Match on your first 6% deferral immediately upon eligibility.
Paid Time Off – Flexible Time Off for Exempt (salaried) employees, as well as generous PTO for Non-Exempt (hourly) employees, plus 11 paid company holidays and a paid volunteer day.
12 weeks of Paid Parental Leave
Maven Family Planning – provides support through your Parenting journey including egg freezing, fertility, adoption, surrogacy, pregnancy, postpartum, early pediatrics, and returning to work.

And SO much more! We continue to enhance our program, so be sure to check our Benefits page here for the latest. Our team can share more during the interview process!

jobs.title: Senior Director, Product Engineering
jobs.description:
Forward was founded in 2013 by four Stanford Ph.D.s, building the industry's first network digital twin: a mathematically accurate model of the production network. It's the foundation for autonomous networking, giving engineers and AI agents the ability to know the impact of every change before it touches production. That founding instinct still defines how we work. We're accurate and evidence-driven, relentless about clarity, and we'd rather be certain than comfortable, building a groundbreaking platform that transforms how teams run and secure networks across every major cloud and vendor environment.

Global leaders like Goldman Sachs, PayPal, S&P Global, IBM, and Dell trust Forward, alongside fast-growing enterprises and government agencies, realizing an average of $14.2 million in annual benefits, according to IDC. Backed by top-tier investors, including A. Capital, Andreessen Horowitz, Goldman Sachs, MSD Partners, Omega Venture Partners, Section 32, and Threshold Ventures, and headquartered in Santa Clara, we're most proud of our team: curious people who'd rather build what doesn't exist than accept how things have always been done.

Forward is looking for a Senior Director of Engineering
to lead our Applications engineering organization. Reporting directly to the SVP of Engineering, you will own an organization of approximately 40 engineers across the US and India responsible for the customer-facing application layer of the Forward platform, spanning both backend and frontend. A significant majority of the organization is based in India, where we expect to continue growing.

This is a broad engineering leadership role with end-to-end accountability for the organization: people, architecture, execution, quality, and delivery. You will lead through engineering managers and senior technical leaders while remaining close enough to the technology to review designs, challenge architectural decisions, and help teams navigate difficult technical problems. You will partner closely with Product Management and UX to shape what we build—not simply execute against a roadmap—bringing engineering judgment into product decisions, challenging requirements and priorities when appropriate, and making pragmatic tradeoffs.

What You’ll Do

Lead and Scale the Applications Organization

Lead an approximately 40-person engineering organization across the US and India, including engineering managers and senior technical leaders.
Build a leadership structure that scales, with clear ownership, accountability, and fast decision-making — including operating practices that let each region decide and deliver without depending unnecessarily on the other.
Coach and develop engineering managers into strong leaders of people, technology, and execution.
Recruit, retain, and develop exceptional talent and build a cohesive engineering culture across geographies and time zones, with particular focus on growing the team and the leadership bench in India.
Create a culture of ownership, technical excellence, accountability, and continuous improvement, and give teams the context and autonomy to execute effectively.

Own Product Engineering and Delivery

Own Forward's application development end to end: requirements and architecture through implementation, testing, release, and ongoing improvement.
Partner with Product Management and UX on product direction, scope, priorities, and delivery plans, constructively challenging assumptions and proposing alternatives that lead to better customer or business outcomes.
Establish realistic plans and estimates, identify dependencies and risks early, and drive predictable execution across multiple concurrent initiatives.
Communicate progress, tradeoffs, risks, and changes clearly to engineering and company leadership.

Drive Technical Excellence and Quality

Provide technical leadership across a modern application stack, including Java backend services and Svelte-based frontend applications. This is not a coding role, but you should be comfortable reviewing designs, asking difficult technical questions, evaluating tradeoffs, and guiding teams toward scalable, maintainable solutions.
Partner closely with Distinguished Engineers and other senior technical leaders to establish and evolve architecture and engineering standards.
Hold the organization to high standards for performance, scalability, security, maintainability, and user experience, balancing product velocity against technical investment so that short-term decisions do not compromise long-term product health.
Own release readiness and product quality — feature validation, automated testing, regression coverage, performance, security, production readiness — as an engineering responsibility throughout the development lifecycle, partnering with our dedicated QA organization on test strategy, plans, and automation.
Drive continuous improvement in engineering practices (design reviews, code reviews, development workflows, release processes), and use defects, production issues, and customer feedback to identify systemic improvements rather than isolated fixes.

Build an AI-Native Engineering Organization

Continue evolving how the organization applies AI across the software development lifecycle — coding, testing, debugging, code review, and design — to improve engineering productivity and product quality.
Encourage experimentation with AI-assisted development while establishing practices that produce measurable improvements in engineering outcomes.

Required

What We’re Looking For

10+ years of software engineering experience, including 5+ years leading engineering teams and managers.
Experience leading a sizable, multi-team engineering organization and scaling both the organization and its leadership structure, working through managers and senior individual contributors rather than direct involvement in every project.
Strong technical background building sophisticated enterprise software, with the depth to evaluate architecture and design decisions across backend and frontend systems and effectively challenge senior engineers.
Track record of delivering complex software products with accountability for schedule, quality, and technical outcomes, balancing roadmap delivery against architecture, technical debt, and longer-term engineering investments.
Experience partnering closely with Product Management and UX/Design, including influencing product requirements, priorities, scope, and strategy.
Strong organizational and planning skills across multiple initiatives, dependencies, resources, and risks.
Excellent written and verbal communication, including conveying technical decisions, tradeoffs, risks, and organizational issues to senior leadership.
A leadership style built around ownership, high standards, transparency, and developing strong leaders.

Nice to Have

Experience building on-premises or self-hosted enterprise software.
Experience leading engineering organizations distributed across the US and India.
Experience building applications using Java and modern frontend frameworks.
Experience with networking concepts, including Layer 2/3 protocols, network infrastructure, network security, or network visibility and management products.
Experience applying AI tools across the software development lifecycle and driving adoption across engineering teams.

Location

This is a regular, full-time position with Forward. Our headquarters are in Santa Clara, California; employees based near the office currently work from the office two days per week. We are also open to remote candidates in the United States. The role requires occasional travel, including approximately 1–2 trips to India per year.

Base Salary Range:
$270,000 – $350,000 per year

This range represents the low and high end of the salary for this position. Actual compensation will vary based on factors including location, candidate experience, skills, and level. In addition to the base salary, you will also receive an annualized bonus.
