new_jobs.description:
Please Note

To provide the best candidate experience amidst our high application volumes, each candidate is limited to 10 applications across all open jobs within a 6-month period.

Advancing the World’s Technology Together

Our technology solutions power the tools you use every day--including smartphones, electric vehicles, hyperscale data centers, IoT devices, and so much more. Here, you’ll have an opportunity to be part of a global leader whose innovative designs are pushing the boundaries of what’s possible and powering the future.

We believe innovation and growth are driven by an inclusive culture and a diverse workforce. We’re dedicated to empowering people to be their true selves. Together, we’re building a better tomorrow for our employees, customers, partners, and communities.

What You’ll Do

In this role as Senior Staff Engineer (Senior Manager), Foundry Silicon Technical Enablement, you will spearhead technical engagements with customers and ASIC partners to define critical product and platform technology requirements, identify and quantify technology gaps, and drive solutions to address these gaps. Collaborating closely with cross-functional teams, including IP, Packaging, Customer Engineering, Design Enablement, ASIC design, and account management, you will foster early technical engagement to enable customized silicon solutions across various technology nodes, ensuring successful delivery of customer-focused outcomes.

You will also drive benchmarking activities to understand the Competitive landscape, set/refine PPA scaling targets, drive necessary recommendations and influence roadmaps to ensure Samsung Foundry continues to stay in leadership position.

Additionally, you will support Business Development activities for new customers in conjunction with account management teams with the goal of securing new business and also exploring differentiated Technology solutions through strategic collaboration.

Location: Daily onsite presence in San Jose HQ location in alignment with our Flexible Work policy with an average of 10% travel per month

Reports to: VP, Technical Marketing

Req: 42975

Develop and build deep trust-based relationships with customers’ teams to understand their Si technology needs, application requirements and jointly define the best technology/platform solutions to enable customer’s products

Work with customer teams to map their requirements to existing foundry offerings, identify potential gaps, and champion their cause by driving internal development teams to address technology needs and deliver technology solutions
Work with the internal Silicon development teams to align on upcoming technology/ scaling trends and set competitive technology targets and differentiated roadmaps
Enable platform solutions (Process, IP, advanced packaging, ASIC etc) with Technology, Ecosystem, Enablement, Design Services and Business development teams. This includes any new potential partnerships with both Internal and External teams
Attend conferences with the goal of publishing regular analysis and benchmarking reports.
Support the Technology engagement and Business growth activities by working with cross-functional teams across Engineering, Sales and Business Development teams to secure customer engagements.
Complete other responsibilities as assigned.

What You Bring

Bachelor’s in Electrical Engineering or related Physical Science with 15+ years of experience or Master’s in Electrical Engineering or related Physical Science with 13+ Years of Industry Experience or PhD in Electrical Engineer or related Physical Science with 10+ years of Industry Experience.
Knowledge of CMOS fundamentals, Device Physics, Advanced Process technology, circuit design concepts, device-technology interactions, scaling trends and their forthcoming challenges.
Experience in Logic Technology development and working with Foundries is a plus.
Broad understanding of systems and application requirements (eg product architecture, key IPs, packaging, design services, ASIC, key standards etc)
Experience with PPA analysis across libraries, memory compilers, Block-level PPA and competitive benchmarking
Experience in Automotive segments requirements including reliability and functional safety. Experience on RF technologies and key figures of merit is a plus.
You’re inclusive, adapting your style to the situation and diverse global norms of our people.
An avid learner, you approach challenges with curiosity and resilience, seeking data to help build understanding.
You’re collaborative, building relationships, humbly offering support and openly welcoming approaches.
Innovative and creative, you proactively explore new ideas and adapt quickly to change.

What We Offer

The pay range below is for all roles at this level across all US locations and functions. Pay within this range varies by work location and may also depend on job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. We also offer incentive opportunities that reward employees based on individual and company performance.

This is in addition to our diverse package of benefits centered around the wellbeing of our employees and their loved ones. In addition to the usual Medical/Dental/Vision/401k, our inclusive rewards plan empowers our people to care for their whole selves. An investment in your future is an investment in ours.

Give Back
With a charitable giving match and frequent opportunities to get involved, we take an active role in supporting the community.

Enjoy Time Away
You’ll start with 4+ weeks of paid time off a year, plus holidays and sick leave, to rest and recharge.

Care for Family
Whatever family means to you, we want to support you along the way—including a stipend for fertility care or adoption, medical travel support, and virtual vet care for your fur babies.

Prioritize Emotional Wellness
With on-demand apps and free confidential therapy sessions, you’ll have support no matter where you are.

Stay Fit
Eating well and being active are important parts of a healthy life. Our onsite Café and gym, plus virtual classes, make it easier.

Embrace Flexibility
Benefits are best when you have the space to use them. That’s why we facilitate a flexible environment so you can find the right balance for you.

Base Pay Range

$189,000—$301,000 USD

Equal Opportunity Employment Policy

Samsung Semiconductor takes pride in being an equal opportunity workplace dedicated to fostering an environment where all individuals feel valued and empowered to excel, regardless of race, religion, color, age, disability, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, ancestry, genetic information, marital status, national origin, political affiliation, or veteran status.

This position provides oversight to an assigned group within software engineering department and provides technical and organizational leadership. This position is responsible for directing and overseeing the work of architects and software engineers within the full software development lifecycle and all levels of testing. This position is also responsible for coordination of application architecture and design of new applications and enhancements to existing applications. Enhancing and collaborating in team environment by demonstrating an expertise in software engineering best practices and leading the team in continuous improvement initiatives.

Direct and manage the functions of the staff to ensure delivery of quality software applications.
Responsible for the strategic direction and its alignment with IT and Early Warning’s strategic goals.
Evaluate existing methodologies/standards, identify and track metrics and recommend process improvements.
Direct and allocate resources and time for all projects and supported functions.
Represent technology organization by collaborating internally and externally.
Represent Software Delivery as a member of cross-functional project teams, estimating test efforts and providing updates on deliverables.
Review project status reports and quality metrics and address issues as appropriate.
Oversee and provide input on test plan creation and execution and creation of test summary.
Direct the ongoing research, evaluation, installation, and usage of automated testing tools for all developed applications.
Provide leadership in directing team to implement automated regression test suites on all production applications.
Build, develop and direct a highly performing team.

Guide other departments in understanding the technical solutions as necessary and helping them with defining ROI for related to proposed solutions
Keeps executive-level management informed of department progress and problems
Support the company’s commitment to risk management and protecting the integrity and confidentiality of systems and data

Minimum Qualifications

Master’s or Bachelor’s in Computer Information Systems/Computer Science
Ten (10) or more years of software engineering experience including at least 5 years of leadership experience
1-2 years of experience implementing application solutions/ services in Cloud using Containerization, CI/CD, Automated testing and in compliance security guidelines
Proven management and leadership skills in leading software engineering teams and their interaction across an organization. A big idea person who can also help with tactical day to day details
Demonstrated abilities in leading teams that build highly scalable products.

Demonstrated experience with state- of- the- art technology, architecture and design concepts, open source operating systems, database systems, computer networking, and security

Ability to envision strategic goals, architectural solutions, and focus on details

Payments experience

Cloud / Kubernetes certification

new_jobs.title: Senior Director, Product Engineering
new_jobs.description:
Forward was founded in 2013 by four Stanford Ph.D.s, building the industry's first network digital twin: a mathematically accurate model of the production network. It's the foundation for autonomous networking, giving engineers and AI agents the ability to know the impact of every change before it touches production. That founding instinct still defines how we work. We're accurate and evidence-driven, relentless about clarity, and we'd rather be certain than comfortable, building a groundbreaking platform that transforms how teams run and secure networks across every major cloud and vendor environment.

Global leaders like Goldman Sachs, PayPal, S&P Global, IBM, and Dell trust Forward, alongside fast-growing enterprises and government agencies, realizing an average of $14.2 million in annual benefits, according to IDC. Backed by top-tier investors, including A. Capital, Andreessen Horowitz, Goldman Sachs, MSD Partners, Omega Venture Partners, Section 32, and Threshold Ventures, and headquartered in Santa Clara, we're most proud of our team: curious people who'd rather build what doesn't exist than accept how things have always been done.

Forward is looking for a Senior Director of Engineering
to lead our Applications engineering organization. Reporting directly to the SVP of Engineering, you will own an organization of approximately 40 engineers across the US and India responsible for the customer-facing application layer of the Forward platform, spanning both backend and frontend. A significant majority of the organization is based in India, where we expect to continue growing.

This is a broad engineering leadership role with end-to-end accountability for the organization: people, architecture, execution, quality, and delivery. You will lead through engineering managers and senior technical leaders while remaining close enough to the technology to review designs, challenge architectural decisions, and help teams navigate difficult technical problems. You will partner closely with Product Management and UX to shape what we build—not simply execute against a roadmap—bringing engineering judgment into product decisions, challenging requirements and priorities when appropriate, and making pragmatic tradeoffs.

What You’ll Do

Lead and Scale the Applications Organization

Lead an approximately 40-person engineering organization across the US and India, including engineering managers and senior technical leaders.
Build a leadership structure that scales, with clear ownership, accountability, and fast decision-making — including operating practices that let each region decide and deliver without depending unnecessarily on the other.
Coach and develop engineering managers into strong leaders of people, technology, and execution.
Recruit, retain, and develop exceptional talent and build a cohesive engineering culture across geographies and time zones, with particular focus on growing the team and the leadership bench in India.
Create a culture of ownership, technical excellence, accountability, and continuous improvement, and give teams the context and autonomy to execute effectively.

Own Product Engineering and Delivery

Own Forward's application development end to end: requirements and architecture through implementation, testing, release, and ongoing improvement.
Partner with Product Management and UX on product direction, scope, priorities, and delivery plans, constructively challenging assumptions and proposing alternatives that lead to better customer or business outcomes.
Establish realistic plans and estimates, identify dependencies and risks early, and drive predictable execution across multiple concurrent initiatives.
Communicate progress, tradeoffs, risks, and changes clearly to engineering and company leadership.

Drive Technical Excellence and Quality

Provide technical leadership across a modern application stack, including Java backend services and Svelte-based frontend applications. This is not a coding role, but you should be comfortable reviewing designs, asking difficult technical questions, evaluating tradeoffs, and guiding teams toward scalable, maintainable solutions.
Partner closely with Distinguished Engineers and other senior technical leaders to establish and evolve architecture and engineering standards.
Hold the organization to high standards for performance, scalability, security, maintainability, and user experience, balancing product velocity against technical investment so that short-term decisions do not compromise long-term product health.
Own release readiness and product quality — feature validation, automated testing, regression coverage, performance, security, production readiness — as an engineering responsibility throughout the development lifecycle, partnering with our dedicated QA organization on test strategy, plans, and automation.
Drive continuous improvement in engineering practices (design reviews, code reviews, development workflows, release processes), and use defects, production issues, and customer feedback to identify systemic improvements rather than isolated fixes.

Build an AI-Native Engineering Organization

Continue evolving how the organization applies AI across the software development lifecycle — coding, testing, debugging, code review, and design — to improve engineering productivity and product quality.
Encourage experimentation with AI-assisted development while establishing practices that produce measurable improvements in engineering outcomes.

Required

What We’re Looking For

10+ years of software engineering experience, including 5+ years leading engineering teams and managers.
Experience leading a sizable, multi-team engineering organization and scaling both the organization and its leadership structure, working through managers and senior individual contributors rather than direct involvement in every project.
Strong technical background building sophisticated enterprise software, with the depth to evaluate architecture and design decisions across backend and frontend systems and effectively challenge senior engineers.
Track record of delivering complex software products with accountability for schedule, quality, and technical outcomes, balancing roadmap delivery against architecture, technical debt, and longer-term engineering investments.
Experience partnering closely with Product Management and UX/Design, including influencing product requirements, priorities, scope, and strategy.
Strong organizational and planning skills across multiple initiatives, dependencies, resources, and risks.
Excellent written and verbal communication, including conveying technical decisions, tradeoffs, risks, and organizational issues to senior leadership.
A leadership style built around ownership, high standards, transparency, and developing strong leaders.

Nice to Have

Experience building on-premises or self-hosted enterprise software.
Experience leading engineering organizations distributed across the US and India.
Experience building applications using Java and modern frontend frameworks.
Experience with networking concepts, including Layer 2/3 protocols, network infrastructure, network security, or network visibility and management products.
Experience applying AI tools across the software development lifecycle and driving adoption across engineering teams.

Location

This is a regular, full-time position with Forward. Our headquarters are in Santa Clara, California; employees based near the office currently work from the office two days per week. We are also open to remote candidates in the United States. The role requires occasional travel, including approximately 1–2 trips to India per year.

Base Salary Range:
$270,000 – $350,000 per year

This range represents the low and high end of the salary for this position. Actual compensation will vary based on factors including location, candidate experience, skills, and level. In addition to the base salary, you will also receive an annualized bonus.

EY-Parthenon’s unique combination of transformative strategy, transactions and corporate finance delivers real-world value – solutions that work in practice, not just on paper. With deep functional and sector expertise, paired with innovative AI-powered technology and an investor mindset, we partner with CEOs, Boards, Private Equity and Governments every step of the way – enabling you to shape your future with confidence.

As a Director in EY-Parthenon’s Strategy & Execution – Deal Technology practice focusing on Health IT, you will lead high-impact engagements that drive both cost optimization and top-line growth across complex transactions and corporate transformations. You will work with C-suite executives, private equity clients, and IT leadership to identify, plan, and execute healthcare technology-driven strategies that enable innovate delivery of patient care, operational efficiencies with health plans, optimize enterprise IT platforms and optimize operational costs while also accelerating revenue and digital innovation during mergers, acquisitions, divestitures, and carve-outs as well as value creation, enterprise re-imagine, and technology transformation initiatives . This role blends deep IT expertise with strategic insight to deliver measurable value through cost transformation, digital/AI enablement, operational efficiency, and tech-enabled growth initiatives.

Within EY-Parthenon's Strategy and Execution sub service line, the Deal Technology Health practice works on the most complex and high-profile healthcare transactions, across a broad portfolio of clients. We are a group of experienced industry professionals with a background in healthcare enterprise technology who are serial transaction and strategic advisers, which enables us to bring a wealth of deep sector and functional knowledge to our clients. This role is focused on advising the Health sector. As a team, we prepare and execute separation and integration plans, identify ideas and sources of value enhancement, as well as advise on risk mitigation and the successful change of enterprise technology platforms, operations, functions, and people.

Key Responsibilities

As a Director with EY-Parthenon's Strategy and Execution Deal Technology – Health practice, you will lead value-creation technology projects that span cost optimization and growth enablement. You’ll guide clients through IT-focused strategies that enhance operational efficiency and unlock new revenue opportunities. Your role will involve advising senior stakeholders, collaborating across functions, and applying emerging technologies (Clinical and revenue cycle management platforms, AI, cloud, data analytics) to deliver measurable business impact. A strong commercial mindset and the ability to balance efficiency with innovation are essential to success in this role.

Skills And Attributes For Success

Build Trusted Relationships - ability to manage senior client relationships and influence client perspectives.
Strong Problem Solving and Storytelling - be a lead for solving problems from beginning to end (problem identification, hypothesis development, synthesis, and recommendation with a compelling narrative).
Outcomes-driven - understand and translate client needs into approach and outcomes for project delivery.
Effective through Collaboration - be part of project teams comprising colleagues from across the EY-Parthenon sub-service lines.
Business and Commercially Driven - working in a fast-paced, exciting environment with strong business acumen to drive value to our clients.
Business Development - ability to drive aspects of pursuits, including presentations and client meetings. Contribute to our practice development initiatives, supporting the continued focus on our team as a great place to work.
Talent Development - coach junior colleagues to become high-performing.
Learning - learn and develop technical and personal skills to support achievement of career goals, through a blend of structured learning, coaching and experiences.

To qualify, you must have

A bachelor’s degree in Business, Engineering, Computer Science, Business Information and Operations Management, Analytics or related field and 5 years of related work experience; or a graduate degree and approximately 3 years of related work experience.
Experience in a healthcare professional services firm or health technology company, IT strategy, digital transformation, and transaction advisory.
Expertise in the following IT skillsets:
Hands-on technical Implementation experience of a major acute EHR platforms (Epic or Cerner) and/or ambulatory platforms (Epic, AthenaHealth, Nextgen, eClinicalworks, etc.)
Enterprise architecture of clinical platforms and revenue cycle management platforms including integration engines such as Cloverleaf, Mirth Connect, or Boomi
Enterprise or solution architecture for modern enterprise/back-office and admin application platforms
Software centric product environments (SaaS, cloud native, API based ecosystems)

Network infrastructure architecture and design (LAN/WLAN, Internet Edge, Zero Trust Security Framework), and SD-WAN
Azure AD, EntraID, MFA, PAM/IAM experience a plus

Certifications in TOGAF®, Agile Scrum (CSM), or ITIL, highly desired.
Proven experience in cost optimization (e.g., AI/Digital Transformation, IT synergy planning, post-merger integration or carve-out execution) and in tech-driven growth initiatives (e.g., implementing a new digital product, scaling technology to deliver excellence of patient, provider, and employee experience).
Ability to synthesize complex technical, financial and operational data into clear, actionable insights; balanced cost efficiency with innovative tech-driven growth strategies.
Comprehensive understanding of IT cost structures – including TCO (total cost of ownership), shared services, outsourcing, and digital transformation levers and an ability to convert various technology/IT opportunities into dollar and financial impact.
Experience in merger & acquisition contexts – e.g., involvement in IT due diligence, IT separation or integration projects, or identifying technology synergies in deals. Understanding deal timelines and how to realize value quickly in a deal timeline is critical.
Leadership & Soft Skills: Proven ability to lead teams and drive change. Excellent client-facing skills with experience advising senior executives. A track record of influencing decision-makers and driving initiatives to completion, especially where technology and business strategy intersect.

new_jobs.title: Senior Manager, Security Operations & Engineering
new_jobs.description:
Job Description

We have an exciting opportunity for a Sr Manager Security Operations & Engineering at UL Research Institutes and UL Standards & Engagement, based in our Evanston, Illinois, office.

The Senior Manager of Security Operations & Engineering leads and strengthens UL Research Institutes (ULRI) and UL Standards & Engagement (ULSE) security operations, ensuring effective prevention, detection, response, and recovery from cyber threats. This role provides strategic and operational oversight across incident response, threat detection, vulnerability management, and security tooling, while aligning efforts with enterprise risk and business goals.

A key partner to IT, Legal, and business teams, this position embeds security into core processes, translates strategy into measurable outcomes, and drives continuous improvement to maintain resilient, audit-ready, and business-aligned security operations.

UL Research Institutes and UL Standards & Engagement

At UL Research Institutes (ULRI) and UL Standards & Engagement (ULSE), we expand the boundaries of safety science to create a more secure and sustainable world. For more than a century, we have studied the unintended consequences of innovation, designed solutions to mitigate risk, created new safety standards and shared our findings with academia, scientists, manufacturers, and policymakers across industries. We identify critical safety and sustainability issues, asking the tough questions because we believe a safer world begins with knowledge.

What You’ll Learn And Achieve

As the Sr Manager Security Operations & Engineering, you will play a key role in the rapid growth of UL as you:

Drive the long-term strategy, roadmap, and operational execution of Security Operations & Engineering in alignment with ULRI and ULSE goals, objectives, enterprise risk priorities, and resilience commitments.
Lead and manage enterprise security operations, including incident response, threat detection, security monitoring, vulnerability management, and operational security engineering.
Own the end-to-end security incident lifecycle, ensuring timely detection, triage, containment, remediation, post-incident reviews, lessons learned, and executive reporting.
Lead the advancement of AI security monitoring, governance, and controls to protect enterprise data, secure internal and external AI use cases, and mitigate emerging AI-driven risks.
Oversee the enterprise vulnerability and exposure management program, including scanning, risk-based prioritization, remediation coordination, metrics, and executive-level reporting.
Drive the implementation, optimization, integration, and operational maturity of security tooling, including SIEM, EDR, MDR, CSPM, DSPM, CNAPP, vulnerability scanners, cloud security platforms, and related security technologies.
Establish and mature security operations processes, playbooks, runbooks, standard operating procedures, and repeatable workflows to improve operational consistency, response effectiveness, and measurable outcomes.
Partner with Identity, Infrastructure, Application, Cloud, and Architecture teams to improve security telemetry, embed security controls into enterprise environments, and strengthen visibility across systems, applications, and data.
Continue to mature Microsoft Purview capabilities, including eDiscovery, Insider Risk Management, Data Loss Prevention, Information Protection, and related data protection controls.
Oversee third-party MSSP security functions, vendor relationships, service provider performance, operational budgets, and annual forecasting for security operations.
Provide executive-level visibility, briefings, metrics, KPIs, dashboards, and risk-based insights to the CISO and senior leadership, including progress against NIST CSF v2 audit findings, compliance requirements, control validation, and enterprise risk reduction objectives.

What you’ll experience working at UL Research Institutes and UL Standards & Engagement:
We have pursued our mission of working for a safer, more secure, and sustainable world for nearly 130 years, embedding conscientious stewardship into everything we do.

People: Our people make us special. You’ll work with a diverse team of experts respected for their independence and transparency and build a network, because our approach is collaborative. We collaborate across disciplines, organizations, and geographies to build the global scientific response that today’s global challenges require.
Interesting work: Every day is different for us here. We see what’s on the horizon and use our expertise to build the foundations of a safer future. You’ll have the opportunity to push the boundaries of human understanding as part of a team working to advance the public good.
Grow and achieve: We learn, work, and grow together through targeted development, reward, and recognition programs.
Values. Four core values guide our work: collaboration, respect, integrity, and beneficence. By living our values, we inspire the trust essential to fulfilling our mission and foster the partnerships that enable us to pursue a beneficent future in which we all can thrive.
Total Rewards: All employees at UL Research Institutes and UL Standards & Engagement are eligible for bonus compensation based on the level of the position. We offer comprehensive medical, dental, vision, and life insurance plans and a generous 401k matching structure of up to 5% of eligible pay. Moreover, we invest an additional 4% into your retirement saving fund after your first year of continuous employment. Depending on your role, you may be able to discuss flexible working arrangements with your manager. We also provide employees with paid time off, including vacation, holiday, sick, and volunteer days.

What Makes You a Great Fit

While no one candidate will embody every quality, the successful candidate will bring many of the following professional competencies and personal attributes:

Ability to conduct comprehensive gap analysis across various business functions and IT systems. Skilled in identifying potential risks and vulnerabilities and developing effective risk mitigation plans and controls.
Strong leadership and people-management skills with the ability to build, mentor, and scale security operations teams.
Demonstrated ability to translate technical security events into clear, risk-based business impacts for executive audiences.
Deep understanding of security operations & engineering concepts, including incident response, threat intelligence, vulnerability management, and monitoring.
Proven experience driving operational maturity using recognized cybersecurity frameworks and best practices.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a data-driven approach to decision-making.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including executive and board-level reporting.
Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, evolving environment.
High degree of integrity, accountability, and professionalism.

Professional Education And Experience Requirements For The Role Include

Bachelor’s degree in Information Security, Computer Science, Information Technology etc. Master’s degree is preferred.

Job Description

This Opportunity

WSP is seeking a talented Vice President – Louisiana, Mississippi, and Alabama Maritime Leader, Ports & Maritime Engineering
professional to join our National Maritime team
at any of the following locations: New Orleans, LA or Baton Rouge, LA.

Provides leadership within the national ports and maritime business line. Ideal candidate shall possess subject matter expertise in planning and design delivery of port/waterfront projects (solid/bulk handling ports including ship and barge docks, multipurpose cargo handling facilities, container terminals, oil/fuel terminals, military facilities, intermodal yards, and passenger terminals) in the region, and signiﬁcant experience in pursuing and proposing on multidisciplinary marine waterfront programs along the Mississippi River. Candidate shall have proven record of designing and delivering PS&E packages with a level of quality that meets or exceeds acceptable industry and company standards for design, safety, and functionality. Hands-on understanding of the maritime market and proven record of meeting and exceeding client objectives is highly desirable.

Your Impact

Provide proactive and strategic leadership for the maritime subsector offering direction, expertise, and support to achieve project and business line expansion goals.
Understand the maritime permitting process and perform engineering review of permit applications, engineering design plans and speciﬁcations, standby plans and engineering contracts, integrated management plans, and periodic construction inspections, to ensure that they comply with applicable state and/or federal regulations and sound engineering practice and standards.
Lead larger-scale multidisciplinary greenﬁeld port development and port redevelopment/reconﬁguration projects ensuring contributors know what they are required to do and by when, preparing and overseeing relevant project budgets, monitoring external events, tracking hours and expenses, ensuring satisfactory performance, and supervising subcontractors, contract work, and employees.
Provide expert technical assistance on various engineering, design, and construction issues relating to marine, port, and coastal systems
Responsible for the capture planning, pursuit, and development of business and the successful execution of traditional maritime/port work all across Louisiana, Mississippi with a speciﬁc focus on Louisiana and private clients including terminal operators along the Mississippi.
Lead technical aspects of contract negotiation, presentations, and meetings.
Support the overall long-term strategy, growth, and pipeline development of Marine Engineering work for WSP in assigned area of responsibility, with a focus on port infrastructure opportunities in all disciplines (planning, design, strategic consulting and program/construction management).
Responsible for the proﬁtable performance of the individual projects and the successful completion of the projects within the speciﬁed area.
Develop a solid client base consisting of various public or private entities or individuals and meet with them regularly to track opportunities and discuss issues relating to a variety of engineering/construction challenges and programs.
Ensure that engineering discipline certiﬁcations, accreditations, and value proposition are developed and continuously improved.
Serve as one of the practice’s lead representatives/liaisons to a variety of external entities including Federal, State, and Local Agencies, Clients, Subcontractors, Port Authorities, industry-related groups, and various government and community entities.
Mentor staff to support their growth and professional development.
Manage and provide performance guidance and leadership to assigned staff.

Collaborate with professionals from a variety of disciplines to provide “trusted advisor” service and future ready solutions for clients.

Bachelor’s Degree in Civil/Structural Engineering, or closely related discipline.
12+ years of relevant post education experience in delivery of marine, port, coastal, and infrastructure projects including hands-on analysis and delivery of PS&E packages, cost estimates and construction oversight.

Competitive compensation, including base pay and annual incentive

Define and execute the strategy, roadmap, and operating model for enterprise data products aligned with business and technology priorities.
Lead the design, engineering, and delivery of scalable, secure, and trusted data solutions leveraging Snowflake and AWS.
Partner with business and technology leaders to prioritize initiatives, drive adoption, and deliver measurable business value.
Establish and promote modern engineering practices across DataOps, automation, observability, governance, quality, and platform reliability.
Drive end-to-end delivery, including data ingestion, integration, transformation, orchestration, testing, deployment, and production support.
Implement strong controls around data quality, metadata, lineage, security, privacy, and regulatory compliance.
Evaluate and adopt emerging technologies, AI-enabled automation, and modern data platform capabilities to accelerate innovation and operational efficiency.
Build, mentor, and lead high-performing engineering teams while managing priorities, risks, dependencies, budgets, and stakeholder expectations.

Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
12+ years of progressive experience in Data Engineering, Data Architecture, Data Platforms, or related disciplines.
Proven experience leading enterprise-scale data initiatives and managing high-performing technical teams.
Experience operating successfully within complex, highly regulated environments preferred.

Talent Needed for Success

Deep expertise with Snowflake, AWS, and modern cloud-native data architectures.
Strong experience building and scaling enterprise data products, platforms, and engineering organizations.
Demonstrated success partnering with executive stakeholders to deliver strategic business outcomes.
Expertise in data engineering concepts including ETL/ELT, CDC, API integrations, streaming, and event-driven architectures.
Strong knowledge of Snowflake capabilities, including data sharing, governance, performance tuning, scalability, and cost optimization.
Hands-on understanding of AWS services, cloud security, IAM, monitoring, resiliency, and automation.
Experience implementing DataOps, CI/CD, automated testing, observability, and production support best practices.
Strong expertise in data quality, metadata management, lineage, governance, privacy, and regulatory controls.
Experience leveraging AI and automation technologies to improve engineering productivity, platform operations, and delivery efficiency.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience building data products within Financial Services, Capital Markets, FinTech, or Banking organizations.
Knowledge of modern lakehouse technologies, including Apache Iceberg, Delta Lake, and Apache Hudi.
Experience with Master Data Management (MDM) and enterprise data governance programs.
Experience leading cloud modernization, technology transformation, and platform evaluation initiatives.
Strong understanding of financial services data domains, including Risk, Regulatory Reporting, Trade & Position, Payments, KYC, and Reference Data.

new_jobs.description:
Capital Markets & Analytics - Senior Director, Product Management

Do you want to be part of a team transforming an entire department by discovering business needs, uncovering where value lies, and working with technology, design, subject-matter experts, and finance professionals to create optimal product and platform solutions? Do you want to help lead the creation and growth of an empowered new product management team? Does the idea of seeing your impact directly with internal customers excite you? If so, we want you!

Capital Markets & Analytics Product Management is a unique and high profile space, responsible for discovering, delivering and optimizing products and capabilities that fundamentally transform how our Capital Markets associates work and enable us to deliver valuable insights using modernized technologies and core data services. In addition to your contributions on overall portfolio and product strategies, you’ll also play a key role in building our Product Management organization. You’ll help shape our culture and our people, provide mentorship for your teammates and be an ambassador for Product Management and for the Finance Product & Data Solutions team.

Our product team is part of a larger group focused on the transformation of Finance at Capital One.

This is a unique Capital Markets opportunity to define and execute on a bold product vision from inception! The Product Manager will collaborate closely with customers including: Treasury, Trading, Balance Sheet Management, and Risk & Capital Analytics.

Our key priorities are revolutionizing the Capital Markets and Analytics platform through:

Product Innovation- Delivering innovative products and platforms, driving forward the vision for Capital Markets across balance sheet risk management, treasury, and trading functions.

Optimization- Re-envisioning and streamlining the overall finance experience inclusive of trading, risk management, collateral management and end of month close.

Data Streamlining- Revamping the data ecosystem to consume and leverage streamlined and enriched data end to end.

In the Product Management role, you will:

Establish the vision, strategy, and execution of Treasury, Trading, and bank balance sheet risk management products, data, and services through understanding of the strategic Finance direction and technology architecture and big picture business needs.
Create frameworks for and directly manage the prioritization of the work, capabilities, components, and infrastructures that are used by multiple customer solutions and customer facing products.
Confidently communicate and evangelize product and portfolio strategy across large organizations and executives to influence stakeholders to align behind the objectives
Create and provide frameworks for regularly and systematically using data to uncover opportunities, track product performance, and drive decision making
Prioritize, negotiate and remove blockers to orchestrate successful launch or optimization cycles
Inspire, enable and empower teams to execute with a sense of urgency to deliver solutions and on priorities

What we are looking for:

Proven experience in and passion for ideating, building and implementing great digital products
Experience with Treasury and Capital Markets products and data
Experience in organizational change management including transforming and improving ways of working and interaction models
Deep knowledge of the Product Management discipline and experience in building and maturing Product teams
Strong ability to set a vision and lead, develop and inspire teams to develop innovative products that have high adoption and drive value for internal customers
Exceptional communication skills -- an engaging storyteller at ease presenting to executives
Creative problem solver who provides leadership at the intersection of the human, business and technology dimensions.
Blend of both strategic and tactical thinking -- someone who can identify and prioritize opportunities in highly ambiguous contexts, and then organize work in deep detail; aligning long term vision with iterative execution
Aptitude to champion strategic technology initiatives to leap-frog current constraints and deliver transformational value
Strong quantitative background to support data-informed decision making
Collaborative, team player attitude with the ability to navigate and influence the organization
Superior problem-solving skills with strong strategic, white-spacing thinking
Inspiring people leader

Capital One Product Framework

In this role, you’ll be expected to demonstrate proficiency in five key areas which we consider to be the foundation for successful Product management:

Human Centered - Obsesses about internal and external customer needs to reimagine and innovate product solutions
Business Focused - Delivers game-changing outcomes by focusing on leverage and execution excellence
Technology Driven - Leverages technology to deliver innovative and resilient solutions that enable both near term and long term value
Integrated Problem Solving - Identifies and resolves complex problems to deliver outcomes while mitigating product risks
Transformational Leadership - Leads cross functional teams to solve customer problems and drive organizational alignment

Basic Qualifications:

Bachelor's degree
At least 7 years of Product Management experience

Preferred Qualifications:

Experience translating business strategy and analysis into consumer facing digital products
Chartered Financial Analyst (CFA) certification
Data Management Experience
3+ years of Agile Product Management experience

About Eon

Eon is transforming how enterprises think about cloud backup- turning backup data from a passive insurance policy into an active, strategic business asset.

As enterprises increasingly build on cloud, data, and AI infrastructure, Eon is creating a new category around Cloud Backup Posture Management (CBPM), helping organizations gain visibility, security, resilience, and access across their cloud environments.

We’re looking for a strategic partnerships leader to help us build relationships with the companies shaping the future of AI, data, and cloud infrastructure.

The Opportunity

This is not a traditional BD/alliances role.

As Director, Strategic Technology Partnerships, you will build and own a focused portfolio of high-value relationships across the AI and Data ecosystem, with a particular focus on AI infrastructure providers, neoclouds and foundation model companies.

Your job will be to identify where Eon and these companies can create unique value together — and then turn those ideas into real partnerships, technology integrations, and significant business opportunities.

You’ll operate at the intersection of technology, and commercial execution, working directly with Eon’s executive team and closely with Product, Engineering, Sales, and Marketing.

The opportunities may not always have an existing playbook. You’ll be expected to find them, shape them, and make them happen.

What You'll Do

Build and own strategic relationships with a focused set of high-value companies across the AI, Data, and cloud infrastructure ecosystem.
Develop trusted relationships with executives, business leaders, product teams, and technical decision-makers.
Identify opportunities for Eon to become strategically embedded within emerging AI and data ecosystems.
Create and drive non-traditional partnership models, including technology integrations, joint GTM, OEM/licensing, infrastructure partnerships, co-selling, and strategic commercial agreements.
Identify relationships that can translate into large enterprise customer opportunities and work with Sales to develop them.
Partner with Product and Engineering to evaluate and prioritize strategic integrations and technology opportunities.
Develop business cases and partnership strategies, align internal stakeholders, and drive opportunities from concept through execution.
Represent Eon externally and build our presence and reputation across the AI and Data ecosystem.
Bring market intelligence and ecosystem insights back to Eon to influence product, technology, and GTM strategy.
Help establish the playbook for Eon’s strategic technology partnerships as the function evolves.

What We're Looking For

8+ years of experience in strategic partnerships, business development, enterprise technology sales, or a related role.
Deep knowledge of the AI, Data, and cloud infrastructure landscape and a strong understanding of where the ecosystem is heading.
A strong network of relationships with senior leaders across AI infrastructure, neoclouds, foundation model companies, data platforms, or adjacent technology companies.
A track record of creating and closing complex, non-standard strategic partnerships or commercial opportunities.
Experience developing technology partnerships, integrations, OEM/licensing models, joint GTM motions, infrastructure partnerships, or strategic enterprise deals.
Strong technical credibility and the ability to engage comfortably with Product, Engineering, and technical executives.
Exceptional commercial judgment — you can connect technical possibilities with meaningful business outcomes.
Strong executive presence, communication, negotiation, and relationship-building skills.
Entrepreneurial mindset and the ability to operate effectively without an established playbook.
A builder who is equally comfortable opening doors, developing the strategy, and driving execution.

Experience working with leading AI infrastructure, neocloud, foundation model, data, and AI platform companies is a strong advantage.

Why Eon

You’ll have the opportunity to build something from the ground up at a company operating at the intersection of cloud, data, security, and AI.

This role offers significant ownership, direct access to Eon’s leadership team, and the ability to influence not just partnerships, but our broader technology and go-to-market strategy.

If you know the AI and Data ecosystem, have a strong network, and love turning unconventional ideas into high-impact partnerships, this is a chance to build something that doesn’t exist yet.

Small businesses represent 99.9% of all companies, yet they're still forced to choose between clunky, outdated enterprise phone systems or their personal phones. This multi-billion dollar market has been overlooked for decades, left to cobble together solutions that slow them down instead of helping them grow.

Quo is changing that. We bring calls, texts, and customer information together into one easy-to-use, AI-powered platform. We’re not just building a phone system. We’re setting a new standard for how businesses connect with their customers.

Driven by our values, we move fast, build with determination, and obsess over delivering value to the businesses that have been underserved for far too long.

Today, Quo is trusted by more than 120,000 companies and rated #1 in customer satisfaction on G2. We’re backed by Y Combinator, Tiger Global, Craft Ventures, Slow Ventures, and other top-tier investors. It’s safe to say we’re onto something big.

About The Role

Quo runs a real-time communications platform, and everything our customers experience — calls that connect instantly, messages that deliver reliably, integrations that just work — rests on infrastructure that has to be fast, resilient, and boring in the best possible way. This role owns the product direction for the two teams that make that possible: Scale & Reliability
and Platform Engineering
.

You'll treat platform and infrastructure as a product, with developer efficiency,reducing infrastructure-driven incidents and development risk
as your North Star. You'll set roadmap and priorities across reliability investment and platform capabilities, partner deeply with senior engineering leaders, negotiate with peer PMs, and make the hard tradeoffs between velocity, cost, and resilience explicit and defensible. You'll be the connective tissue across engineering, product, and design, a force multiplier who turns strategy into a sequenced, funded, and delivered roadmap, keeping complex, multi-team programs on track from scoping through launch and retrospective.

This is a technical PM role. You won't write the code, but you'll be fluent in the architecture, comfortable in a design review, and credible with staff and principal engineers.

Some Of The Things You’ll Do

Own the business case for Platform — represent the team's priorities to executives and hold the roadmap accountable to measurable outcomes, not just delivery.
Own reliability as a product discipline — Service Level Objectives and platform health observability to reduce errors and incidents across our services, and negotiate with peer PMs to balance velocity with stability.
Build for the future — capacity planning ahead of growth, and the product side of incident management, from postmortem to funded fix.
Set the internal developer platform roadmap — paved paths, shared services, and self-serve tooling — with developer velocity and adoption as first-class metrics.
Hold the line on real-time performance — latency and media quality where milliseconds are the product.
Steer on the metrics that matter — uptime, latency, incident load, adoption, unit cost — using data and judgment to decide when to slow down and when to ship, and to make that case to product, engineering, and finance alike.
Run intake and prioritization of the Platform backlog — balancing business needs, technical requirements, and team capacity, and partnering with engineering leads to plan and staff initiatives.
Surface risks early and drive resolution — proactively identify technical risks, capacity constraints, and architectural gaps, and escalate to leadership with clear context and a recommended path forward.

About You

5+ years in product management, including meaningful time as a technical, platform, or infrastructure PM (or an eng/SRE-to-PM path ).
Technical fluency in distributed systems — you can hold your own on architecture, APIs, cloud infrastructure, and the failure modes of systems at scale.
Hands-on experience with Service Level Objective frameworks, on-call, and incident management — you've lived the reliability lifecycle with an at-scale service.
A platform-as-a-product mindset: you understand that internal developers are customers, and that adoption is earned.
Strong partnership skills with staff/principal engineers and engineering leaders — you build trust through clear thinking and technical credibility.
Data-driven and outcome-oriented, with the judgment to know which metric is actually the one that matters.
High ownership mentality — you treat the programs you run as your own and do what it takes to make them succeed.

Nice to have

Background in real-time systems, telephony/VoIP/CPaaS, or messaging — or in another domain where high-availability, multi-tenant, latency-sensitive infrastructure is non-negotiable (e.g., identity/security, payments, streaming).
Experience standing up or scaling an internal developer platform.
Familiarity with cost/efficiency optimization at cloud scale.
Exposure to compliance-driven delivery (SOC 2, HIPAA, FedRAMP, ISO 27001).

Compensation

The annual base salary range for this position in the US is $165,000 - $194,000 USD, and in Canada is $166,000 - $196,000 CAD, plus equity and benefits. This range is designed to align with market rates in areas where we are actively recruiting across the US and Canada.

The range displayed reflects the target for new hire salaries, and within this range, individual pay is determined by your skills and experience, as well as relevant education. Your recruiter can share more and answer questions about the specific salary range during the hiring process.

Salary is just one component of Quo’s total compensation package. Your total rewards package will include equity, extensive medical coverage, a monthly lifestyle stipend, and a flexible PTO policy.

Who We Are

We're a remote-first company with a culture of trust, autonomy, and action. As we rapidly grow, we're intentionally building communities in a handful of hub cities while continuing to hire great talent wherever they happen to live. If you're looking for a place to do your best work, we'd love to hear from you.

And remember, there's no such thing as a 'perfect' candidate. We're looking for optimists with grit and determination, who are excited to face the challenges of a growing startup. Quo is the type of company where you can grow, and we encourage you to apply for this role even if you don't think you meet all the requirements.

We are committed to creating an inclusive and diverse work environment. It is important that you are able to bring your authentic self to work every day. Description

At Northrop Grumman, our employees have incredible opportunities to work on revolutionary systems that impact people's lives around the world today, and for generations to come. Our pioneering and inventive spirit has enabled us to be at the forefront of many technological advancements in our nation's history - from the first flight across the Atlantic Ocean, to stealth bombers, to landing on the moon. We look for people who have bold new ideas, courage and a pioneering spirit to join forces to invent the future, and have fun along the way. Our culture thrives on intellectual curiosity, cognitive diversity and bringing your whole self to work — and we have an insatiable drive to do what others think is impossible. Our employees are not only part of history, they're making history.

Northrop Grumman’s Defense Systems sector is looking for a Director for Sentinel Specialty Engineering
within the Strategic Deterrent Systems Division. This position will be located in Roy, Utah or Huntsville, AL
and will support the Sentinel program. Northrop Grumman supports the Air Force’s sustainment, development, production and deployment of hardware and system modifications for Intercontinental Ballistic Missile (ICBM) Ground and Airborne Launch Control Systems, Launch Facilities and associated infrastructure.

What You Will Get To Do

Lead the Specialty Engineering organization within Sentinel Systems Engineering, supporting the Systems Engineering Element Lead.
Direct the implementation of specialty system engineering requirements and processes across the program segments, driving consistency and implementation across program/product teams at all national locations and multiple subcontractor locations.
Management (CAM) of specialty engineering work scope including planning, budgeting, and reporting.
Coordination of specialty engineering topics across various integrated product teams (IPTs).
Leadership and coordination of internal and external stakeholder engagements (engineering review boards, change control boards, customer sync meetings, formal working groups, and others).
Ensuring flow, decomposition, and satisfaction of specialty engineering requirements and design compliance according to Sentinel processes and governance.
Establish and direct the implementation of model-based digital engineering processes used in the design and development of Sentinel, at all levels of decomposition.
Ensure specialty engineering product quality and consistency for the Sentinel program.
Interface closely with the product/program team leadership and implement systems engineering priorities for the team.
Provide technical leadership and oversight for Specialty Engineering (Human Systems Integration, Nuclear Hardness and Survivability, E3, and System Safety) including mentoring high potential leaders and advising program lead

Additional Responsibilities May Include

Horizontally integrate across System Engineering directorate as well as members of the Engineering and Manufacturing Operations organization to ensure consistency of systems engineering approach. This will help identify areas of opportunity to support upcoming challenges that are not currently being elevated.
Provide independent review of portfolio software, hardware and deliverables, focused deep dives in program and product teams, as well as driving compliance to processes and procedures.
Identify opportunities for and support of engagement activities across all programs.
Identify and mentor high potential technical leaders.
Provide advisement to all program leads (as required) and embedded resources.

As a full-time employee of Northrop Grumman Defense Systems, you are eligible for our robust benefits package including:

Medical, Dental & Vision coverage
401k
Educational Assistance
Life Insurance
Employee Assistance Programs & Work/Life Solutions
Paid Time Off
Health & Wellness Resources
Employee Discounts

This positions standard work schedule is a 9/80. The 9/80 schedule allows employees who work a nine-hour day Monday through Thursday to take every other Friday off. This position may offer relocation assistance.

You'll Bring These Qualifications

Bachelor’s Degree in STEM with at least 10 years of progressive engineering experience, or Master’s and 8 years’ of experience.
Experience leading engineering teams/and or organizations to achieve a common goal.
Active US Government Secret clearance, investigation must have been completed within last 5 years

These Qualifications Would Be Nice To Have

ICBM or complex aerospace systems experience
Experience in Human Systems Integration, Nuclear Hardness and Survivability, Electromagnetic Environmental Effects (E3), System Safety, Specialty Integration, and Compliance Requirements/Verification
Model-Based Systems Engineering (MBSE) experience
Design Engineering/Computer-aided Design (CAD) experience
Prior experience interfacing with prime contractor site leads and USAF leadership personnel
Prior experience with Air Force Range Safety
Active DoD TS/SCI clearance
Experience leading the performance of tasks on schedule, at cost and achieving all requirements as either project lead, integrated program team or cost account manager
Demonstrated effectiveness in achieving results through managing people and management of internal processes and customer/supplier relationships.
Strong understanding and broad application of complex engineering systems (engineering standards, configuration management, material review board, process control, tooling, facilities, software, etc.)
Strong oral and written communication skills, including demonstrated experience with high value customer presentations, with ability to focus on multiple projects with competing priorities
Experience in working closely with customers to ensure delivery of systems that meet warfighter needs
Ability to collaborate and achieve consensus when dealing with groups from diverse organizations and backgrounds
Demonstrated experience in making sound decisions in uncertain and difficult situations
Strong sense of urgency and work ethic in ensuring engineering meets customer and program expectations in a timely and efficient manner

Primary Level Salary Range: $193,800.00 - $321,000.00

Job Description

This Opportunity

WSP is seeking a talented Vice President – Louisiana, Mississippi, and Alabama Maritime Leader, Ports & Maritime Engineering
professional to join our National Maritime team
at any of the following locations: New Orleans, LA or Baton Rouge, LA.

Provides leadership within the national ports and maritime business line. Ideal candidate shall possess subject matter expertise in planning and design delivery of port/waterfront projects (solid/bulk handling ports including ship and barge docks, multipurpose cargo handling facilities, container terminals, oil/fuel terminals, military facilities, intermodal yards, and passenger terminals) in the region, and signiﬁcant experience in pursuing and proposing on multidisciplinary marine waterfront programs along the Mississippi River. Candidate shall have proven record of designing and delivering PS&E packages with a level of quality that meets or exceeds acceptable industry and company standards for design, safety, and functionality. Hands-on understanding of the maritime market and proven record of meeting and exceeding client objectives is highly desirable.

Your Impact

Provide proactive and strategic leadership for the maritime subsector offering direction, expertise, and support to achieve project and business line expansion goals.
Understand the maritime permitting process and perform engineering review of permit applications, engineering design plans and speciﬁcations, standby plans and engineering contracts, integrated management plans, and periodic construction inspections, to ensure that they comply with applicable state and/or federal regulations and sound engineering practice and standards.
Lead larger-scale multidisciplinary greenﬁeld port development and port redevelopment/reconﬁguration projects ensuring contributors know what they are required to do and by when, preparing and overseeing relevant project budgets, monitoring external events, tracking hours and expenses, ensuring satisfactory performance, and supervising subcontractors, contract work, and employees.
Provide expert technical assistance on various engineering, design, and construction issues relating to marine, port, and coastal systems
Responsible for the capture planning, pursuit, and development of business and the successful execution of traditional maritime/port work all across Louisiana, Mississippi with a speciﬁc focus on Louisiana and private clients including terminal operators along the Mississippi.
Lead technical aspects of contract negotiation, presentations, and meetings.
Support the overall long-term strategy, growth, and pipeline development of Marine Engineering work for WSP in assigned area of responsibility, with a focus on port infrastructure opportunities in all disciplines (planning, design, strategic consulting and program/construction management).
Responsible for the proﬁtable performance of the individual projects and the successful completion of the projects within the speciﬁed area.
Develop a solid client base consisting of various public or private entities or individuals and meet with them regularly to track opportunities and discuss issues relating to a variety of engineering/construction challenges and programs.
Ensure that engineering discipline certiﬁcations, accreditations, and value proposition are developed and continuously improved.
Serve as one of the practice’s lead representatives/liaisons to a variety of external entities including Federal, State, and Local Agencies, Clients, Subcontractors, Port Authorities, industry-related groups, and various government and community entities.
Mentor staff to support their growth and professional development.
Manage and provide performance guidance and leadership to assigned staff.
Remain current in latest marine, port, and coastal engineering techniques and practices. Be acquainted with the capital investment programs of all leading regional public ports at a minimum.
Collaborate with professionals from a variety of disciplines to provide “trusted advisor” service and future ready solutions for clients.
Exercise responsible and ethical decision-making regarding company funds, resources and conduct, and adhere to WSP’s Code of Conduct and related policies and procedures.
Perform additional responsibilities as required by business needs.

Who You Are

Required Qualifications

Bachelor’s Degree in Civil/Structural Engineering, or closely related discipline.
12+ years of relevant post education experience in delivery of marine, port, coastal, and infrastructure projects including hands-on analysis and delivery of PS&E packages, cost estimates and construction oversight.
Engineer license required (LA PE is necessary, MS/AL preferred).
Advanced proﬁciency with marine, port, and coastal engineering principles, practices, project delivery modes such as design/build, standard of care, and the application to project work-related issues.
Strong working knowledge of relevant marine, port, and coastal construction laws, codes, regulations, compliance practices, and record-keeping requirements, and the business impact upon the organization.
Advanced proﬁciency in making technical computations and calculations including seismic designs of ports involving the application of engineering principles, understanding plans and speciﬁcations and making factual comparisons to the appropriate regulations.
Works independently and provides guidance and leadership to mid-level to senior level team or project members, with strict adherence to QA/QC.
Excellent leadership and interpersonal communication skills with the ability to effectively, persuasively, and tactfully interact with employees at all levels of the organization.
Tactical lateral thinking and strong analytical skills with attention to detail and prioritization of responsibilities in a pressure work environment.
Ability to elicit cooperation from a wide variety of sources, including senior management, clients, regulators, architects, and company-wide staff, including those with whom no formal hierarchical relationship exits.
Advanced proﬁciency with office automation, load calculations, discipline-speciﬁc design software (i.e., SAP2000, OPTIMOOR), technology, math principles, predictive models, spreadsheets, and tools.
Proven track record of upholding workplace safety and ability to abide by WSP’s health, safety and drug/alcohol and harassment policies.
Strong ability to quickly adapt to change and demonstrate ﬂexibility to a variety of schedules and hours to meet business needs.
Travel is required to meet with clients, develop opportunities, and address project-speciﬁc requirements.

Preferred Qualifications

Master’s Degree in Civil/Structural Engineering.
Strong experience in managing the review and approval of documents and discipline-specific deliverables, certifications, processes, and plans in a multi-project environment is highly desirable.
Understanding and/or experience in design and operations of bulk terminals, equipment, and support for electrical systems.
Understanding and/or experience with impacts of coastal ﬂooding/exposure to existing port infrastructure.

WSP USA is the U.S. operating company of WSP, one of the world's leading engineering and professional services firms. Dedicated to serving local communities, we are engineers, planners, technical experts, strategic advisors and construction management professionals. WSP USA designs lasting solutions in the buildings, transportation, energy, water and environment markets. With more than 15,000 employees in over 300 offices across the U.S., we partner with our clients to help communities prosper.

www.wsp.com

WSP provides a flexible and agile workplace model while meeting client needs. At WSP, we want to give our employees the challenges they seek to grow their careers and knowledge base. Your daily contributions to your team will be essential in meeting client objectives, goals and challenges. Are you ready to get started?

This position will offer you the opportunity to manage and further grow a project team consisting of engineers and designers involved in the design, modification, and analysis of new and existing high voltage substations.

You will work on challenging assignments that include investigating, trouble-shooting, and implementing solutions to expand and modernize the electric grid.
Direct the Team Lead in the coordination of engineering and design from concept through detailed design execution, field support and closeout.
Support overall account management and client engagement with peer to peer reporting, coordination and conflict resolution.
Lead efforts to ensure projects are completed satisfactorily, on time, and within budget.
Coordinate and execute facility studie for various RTO's.
Coordinate systems design activities to ensure installation and operations will comply with specifications, codes, and client requirements.
Prepare reports and studies that present technical information in a clear and concise manner and meet client requirements and S&L formats.
Perform independent reviews of work performed by others including calculations and drawing preparation.

This role offers a hybrid work arrangement, with the expectation of spending three days a week in the office, giving you the flexibility to work remotely for two days.

Dependent upon your location, this opportunity offers a generous relocation package.

Qualifications

We do not sponsor employees for work authorization in the U.S. for this position.

Essential Skills And Experience

BS from an ABET-accredited engineering program or an advanced management/business degree
Specific hands on experience with MISO facility studies and knowledge of DPP process.
Specific experience in Project Management of Utility Transmission & Distribution Substation Projects.
Knowledge of engineering standards including NEC, NESC, NEMA, IEC, IEEE and ANSI.
20 or more years experience in the design of multi-disciplined solutions in a project team environment for utility high voltage substations. Experience must include an understanding of electrical, civil, structural scopes of work, conceptual development, industry best practices, design basis, the selection of equipment and materials, and the preparation of construction packages.
Five or more years experience in leading an engineering design team through all phases of a project design.
Technically knowledgeable of available equipment and proven pre-engineered systems to execute systems design.
Proven communication skillset both verbal and written in support of presentations, proposals and reports.
Experience with serving as firm/client liaison in a support or lead engineering role.
Experience and understanding of construction documents

PMP Certification.

new_jobs.description:
Client Overview

A well-established organization focused on leveraging technology to drive business growth and operational efficiency is seeking an Information Technology Director
to join its team. The company values innovation and strategic IT leadership to support its evolving needs and is known for fostering a collaborative environment that empowers employees and embraces modern technology solutions.

Salary/Hourly Rate

$170,000

Position Overview

The Information Technology Director will provide strategic and operational leadership for all IT systems, infrastructure, and services. This role partners with business leaders to align technology initiatives with organizational goals, drive innovation, and ensure reliable day-to-day IT operations. The director will oversee IT staff, vendor relationships, and the management of both on-premises and cloud environments.

Responsibilities Of The Information Technology Director

Define and execute the organization’s IT vision, strategy, and roadmap to support business growth and operational efficiency.
Oversee vendor management, including selection, contract negotiation, performance monitoring, and renewals aligned with security and budget requirements.
Lead, mentor, and manage IT staff, including performance management and professional development.
Manage IT department budget and resource allocation to ensure cost-effective operations.
Oversee design, implementation, and maintenance of IT systems, including on-premises and cloud infrastructure, networks, and telecommunications.
Ensure high availability, security, and performance of networks, servers, operating systems, and enterprise applications.
Monitor IT projects, resource utilization, and operational performance, reporting to executive leadership.

Required Experience/Skills For The Information Technology Director

10+ years of IT infrastructure and systems experience, including at least 5 years in a leadership role.
Expertise in Microsoft Autopilot and Intune for device provisioning, deployment, and mobile device management.
Proficient in system engineering functions including Active Directory, Azure, VMware, Office 365, Group Policy, scripting, patching, and automation.
Strong knowledge of IT security policies, network security, firewalls, access controls, and compliance requirements.
Experience leading disaster recovery, backup, and business continuity planning and execution.
Skilled in IT service delivery management, help desk operations, and escalation processes.
Ability to manage user account administration, email systems, and access provisioning.
Experience developing AI governance frameworks and using AI tools such as Microsoft Copilot and Claude to enhance productivity and decision-making.

Preferred Experience/Skills For The Information Technology Director

Proven leadership in managing IT teams within complex organizations, including strong strategic IT planning.
Familiarity with hybrid cloud environments and infrastructure optimization.
Experience with AI integration and governance in enterprise settings.

Education Requirements

Bachelor’s degree in Information Systems or equivalent technical experience.

Benefits

Client-provided benefits available, upon eligibility.
